mech.wanted.gein.invulnerabilite.vulnerabilityDuration: The turn of the character who revealed him
mech.wanted.gein.invulnerabilite.prerequisites.0: At least one Feu des âmes perdues on the field (obtained by casting a summoning spell).
mech.wanted.gein.invulnerabilite.prerequisites.1: Gein is within a radius of 2 around the fire that is hit.
mech.wanted.gein.invulnerabilite.notes.0: Each damage line dealt to Gein gives the attacker 10% erosion (1 turn, stackable) ("Usure" effect).
mech.wanted.gein.invulnerabilite.notes.1: A skull glowing blue indicates that Gein is on an adjacent cell.
mech.wanted.gein.invulnerabilite.unknownAspects.0: Gein's power bonus on each reveal is described once as "infinite and stackable" and once as "for 1 turn (stackable)".
mech.wanted.gein.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.label: Make Gein vulnerable
mech.wanted.gein.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Cast a summoning spell: the summon is replaced by a Feu des âmes perdues.
mech.wanted.gein.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: The character also gains 2 AP for 2 turns.
mech.wanted.gein.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Hit a fire close to Gein, preferably with a low-AP spell.
mech.wanted.gein.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Hitting a fire also gives 5 AP for 1 turn.
mech.wanted.gein.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Hit Gein for the rest of that character's turn.

mech.wanted.gein.teleportation.title: Predict invisible Gein's position (symmetric teleport)
mech.wanted.gein.teleportation.summary: At the end of his turn (or the turn of the character who revealed him), Gein teleports from his position symmetrically relative to the character who plays next; if that cell does not exist, he returns to the cell where he started his turn. Watching where he starts and ends his turn lets you track him.
mech.wanted.gein.teleportation.sequences.0.label: Track him
mech.wanted.gein.teleportation.sequences.0.steps.1.action: During Gein's turn (visible), note his starting cell and ending cell.
mech.wanted.gein.teleportation.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Work out the cell symmetric to his ending cell relative to the character who plays next (otherwise: his starting cell).
mech.wanted.gein.teleportation.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Optional: block him in contact with a fire and apply the Pesanteur state to him (the guide cites Duel, Retraite Anticipée, Flèche écrasante, etc.).
mech.wanted.gein.teleportation.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: He no longer teleports and stays next to the same fire.

mech.wanted.gein.os-tour-11.title: Team killed on turn 11
mech.wanted.gein.os-tour-11.summary: From the start, Gein places an effect on all characters that kills them after 10 turns: if he is still alive on turn 11, the whole team dies.
mech.wanted.gein.os-tour-11.prerequisites.0: Gein must be killed before turn 11.

mech.wanted.gein.feux-zone.title: Avoid the lines and radius 2 of the Feux des âmes perdues
mech.wanted.gein.feux-zone.summary: Gein can swap places with a fire, then pull characters in line (up to 4 cells) and hit around himself; on certain turns he hits in a radius 2 circle around all the fires. Do not stay aligned with the fires, and stay more than 2 range from each one on the relevant turns.
mech.wanted.gein.feux-zone.unknownAspects.0: Contradictory frequency for "Éveil des âmes perdues": "every 3 turns" in the overview, turns 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 in the tips.

mech.wanted.gein.paralysie.title: "Paralysie": poisons on AP and MP used
mech.wanted.gein.paralysie.summary: This spell hits with earth based on eroded HP and applies one poison per AP used and one per MP used. Before spending AP/MP, check the poisons, debuff yourself if possible, avoid moving and limit AP use except for a big hit on a located Gein.

mech.wanted.glourdorak.invulnerabilite.title: "Fonso Cacnoob": the marked character ends their turn in contact
mech.wanted.glourdorak.invulnerabilite.summary: Glourdorak is invulnerable for the whole fight. Each turn, his spell "Gloursofulgur" (3 to 6 range) gives the "Fonso Cacnoob" state to a character. If that character ends their turn in contact with Glourdorak, they cast "Bienjouay Noube" on their adjacent cells and Glourdorak becomes vulnerable until that character's next turn.
mech.wanted.glourdorak.invulnerabilite.vulnerabilityDuration: Until the start of the next turn of the character who unlocked him (about 1 turn)
mech.wanted.glourdorak.invulnerabilite.prerequisites.0: The character has the "Fonso Cacnoob" state.
mech.wanted.glourdorak.invulnerabilite.prerequisites.1: That character ends their turn on a cell adjacent to Glourdorak.
mech.wanted.glourdorak.invulnerabilite.notes.0: After "Fonso Cacnoob", the character receives "Pacette Foinoube" (2 turns): they cannot be targeted again for 3 turns, so you must rotate.
mech.wanted.glourdorak.invulnerabilite.notes.1: The unlocking character cannot hit Glourdorak themselves, unless the next one to receive the state plays before them and extends the vulnerability.
mech.wanted.glourdorak.invulnerabilite.notes.2: Leave tough characters in "Gloursofulgur"'s line of sight and hide the more fragile ones.
mech.wanted.glourdorak.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.label: Unlock Glourdorak
mech.wanted.glourdorak.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Identify the character who received "Fonso Cacnoob".
mech.wanted.glourdorak.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.2.action: With that character, end the turn in contact with Glourdorak.
mech.wanted.glourdorak.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Hit with the characters who play before the unlocking character's next turn.

mech.wanted.glourdorak.tour-5.title: Turn 5: summons killed and team debuffed
mech.wanted.glourdorak.tour-5.summary: On turn 5, Glourdorak kills all summons present and removes all buffs from the characters.

mech.wanted.glourdorak.distance.title: Keep him more than 7 range away and out of line of sight
mech.wanted.glourdorak.distance.summary: His strongest hits are in contact and his ranged spells need line of sight: to stall or after unlocking him, push him more than 7 range away (6 MP + 1) and hide, while leaving one character at 3-6 range to receive the next "Fonso Cacnoob".

mech.wanted.glourdorak.gloursolaser.title: "Gloursolaser": penalty on each damage taken
mech.wanted.glourdorak.gloursolaser.summary: This spell debuffs the target and, for 2 turns, each damage instance it takes removes power (100, stackable) and resistances from it, in exchange for heals.
mech.wanted.glourdorak.gloursolaser.unknownAspects.0: The details of the resistance loss are given in an image that is not readable in the extracted text.

mech.wanted.glourdorak.allies-de-circons.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.glourdorak.allies-de-circons.summary: Effect common to wanted bosses: -2000 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.gobrechaun.parite.title: Protection based on turn parity
mech.wanted.gobrechaun.parite.summary: Odd turns: Gobrechaun dodges 100% of melee hits by stepping back one cell (equivalent to melee invulnerability) — hit him at range. Even turns: he is invulnerable at range — hit him in contact.
mech.wanted.gobrechaun.parite.sequences.0.label: Alternate your hits
mech.wanted.gobrechaun.parite.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Odd turn: attack him at range.
mech.wanted.gobrechaun.parite.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Even turn: attack him in melee.

mech.wanted.gobrechaun.fortune.title: "Fortune": random bonuses/penalties on every interaction
mech.wanted.gobrechaun.fortune.summary: Every time a monster or character takes damage, is moved, undergoes an AP/MP/range removal attempt or is debuffed, a random bonus (monsters) or a random penalty (characters) is applied for 1 turn, stackable. The bonuses rarely (3%) include an Invulnerable, Invulnerable at range or Invulnerable in melee state.
mech.wanted.gobrechaun.fortune.sequences.0.label: Guide's tips
mech.wanted.gobrechaun.fortune.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Hit Gobrechaun with powerful single-damage-line spells.
mech.wanted.gobrechaun.fortune.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: Limit the number of bonuses triggered, including the invulnerable states.
mech.wanted.gobrechaun.fortune.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Every hit a character takes triggers a penalty.
mech.wanted.gobrechaun.fortune.sequences.0.steps.3.action: If he gets an Invulnerable state from a bonus, wait for it to expire (1 turn).

mech.wanted.gobrechaun.lance-en-ciel.title: "Lance-en-Ciel": poison on MP used
mech.wanted.gobrechaun.lance-en-ciel.summary: This spell applies a water poison triggered by MP used: check the effect before moving, limit movement or debuff yourself.

mech.wanted.gobrechaun.allies-de-circons.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.gobrechaun.allies-de-circons.summary: Effect common to wanted bosses: -700 vitality (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.homard-medali.invulnerabilit.title: Invulnerable after "Télépunch", removed by a melee hit
mech.wanted.homard-medali.invulnerabilit.summary: Medali is not invulnerable by default. If he hits a target with "Télépunch" (2 to 5 range, place swap), he becomes invulnerable with no time limit; a single melee hit (character or summon) makes him vulnerable again.
mech.wanted.homard-medali.invulnerabilit.prerequisites.0: Medali has hit a target with "Télépunch".
mech.wanted.homard-medali.invulnerabilit.notes.0: He will very likely make himself invulnerable again on his next turn if he can hit someone.
mech.wanted.homard-medali.invulnerabilit.sequences.0.label: Make him vulnerable
mech.wanted.homard-medali.invulnerabilit.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Hit Medali once in melee, preferably with a cheap spell (the guide cites Flamiche) and with the first character to play.

mech.wanted.homard-medali.bain-de-houle.title: "Bain de houle": power per distant character
mech.wanted.homard-medali.bain-de-houle.summary: At the start of each of his turns, Medali gains 15 power (infinite, stackable) for each character more than 3 range from him: the longer the fight lasts, the harder he hits.

mech.wanted.homard-medali.jeu-distance.title: Play at range: stay out of his reach
mech.wanted.homard-medali.jeu-distance.summary: Guide's method: push him back, place him far away or remove his MP so he cannot hit anyone. Without MP removal, stay more than 12 range away at the start of his turn (5 MP + "Hypercut" up to 7 range); beyond 10 range, he cannot use "Télépunch" and does not become invulnerable. Alternative: play in contact and unlock him each turn in melee, staying within a radius of 3 range and killing him fast.
mech.wanted.homard-medali.jeu-distance.notes.0: The guide advises killing the accompanying monsters first, especially the Mantazes.

mech.wanted.homard-medali.drache.title: Draché state: bonus line of 20% of HP
mech.wanted.homard-medali.drache.summary: "Drachetaulque" (water, melee) pushes back and gives the Draché state for 2 turns; if he casts this spell again on a Draché target, he adds a water damage line equal to 20% of the target's HP.

mech.wanted.homard-medali.allies-de-circ.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.homard-medali.allies-de-circ.summary: Effect common to wanted bosses: -2000 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.title: "Héliopolis": one damage line makes him vulnerable for 3 turns
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.summary: The Khepricorne is invulnerable. Dealing him at least one damage line (even for 0) is enough: at the start of his next turn, he becomes vulnerable for 3 turns, but then gains lock, 3 MP, MP dodge, the Intaclable state, a damage reduction, and summons an invulnerable Boule Puante in contact with him.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.expectedStateChange: Vulnerable from the start of his next turn; a Boule Puante is summoned.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.prerequisites.0: At least one damage line dealt to the Khepricorne.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.notes.0: When he becomes invulnerable again, he eliminates the Boule Puante and hits all characters within a radius of 2 around it with fire.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.notes.1: Make him vulnerable quickly: while invulnerable, he steals characteristics in a stackable way (part of it infinite).
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Bring characters who hit with water or air.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: He has lower resistances in water (5%) and air (10%).
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Make him vulnerable as soon as possible: deal him at least one damage line, even for 0.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Héliopolis": at the start of his next turn, he becomes vulnerable for 3 turns. While invulnerable, "Bouse de Feu" steals characteristics, part of them infinitely and stackably.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.3.action: During the 3 vulnerable turns, focus damage on him to eliminate him quickly.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: While vulnerable, he gains 20 lock, 3 MP, 50 MP dodge, the Intaclable state and a 10 damage reduction (110 actual per hit) for 3 turns.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Stay away from him and his Boule Puante, even at the cost of the penalty beyond 6 range.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.4.position: Far from the Khepricorne and the Boule
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: While vulnerable, he can only target his Boule: if it is close to him and far from you, he becomes harmless. At the start of his turn, those in contact with him are pushed back one cell; those more than 6 range away lose 6 range and 3 AP for 1 turn.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Do not move the Khepricorne more than 10 range from his Boule Puante.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: Otherwise, at the start of his turn, all characters take 750 fire damage.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Do not stay in line with the Boule Puante.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: "Roulé-bousé" pushes it back 28 cells (heavy pushback damage if you block it) and hits for 900 earth + Pesanteur along the whole line.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.7.action: Do not stay next to the Boulettes Puantes he summons around the characters.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.7.rationale: When they die, they apply 5% erosion, hit for 500 water on adjacent cells and heal their allies in contact.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.8.action: At the end of the 3 turns, move away from the Boule; if he is not dead, start again from step 2.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.8.rationale: When he becomes invulnerable again, he eliminates the Boule and hits all characters in a radius 2 circle around it for 550 fire.

mech.wanted.khepricorne.debut-de-tour.title: Distance effects at the start of each of his turns
mech.wanted.khepricorne.debut-de-tour.summary: At the start of each of his turns: characters in contact with him are pushed back one cell; those more than 6 range away lose 6 range and 3 AP for 1 turn; if he and his Boule Puante are more than 10 range apart, all characters take 750 fire damage.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.debut-de-tour.notes.0: Moving the Khepricorne away from his Boule triggers a hit on the whole team.

mech.wanted.khepricorne.boule-puante.title: While vulnerable, he only targets his Boule Puante: stay far away and out of its lines
mech.wanted.khepricorne.boule-puante.summary: While vulnerable, his spells only target the Boule Puante (28-cell push with earth damage and Pesanteur along the line, pulls, trap, areas around the Boule, place swap with a heal of about 3000 HP). The guide advises staying far from him and the Boule while keeping them close to each other, and not staying in line with the Boule.
mech.wanted.khepricorne.boule-puante.notes.0: Do not stay next to the Boulettes Puantes: when they die they erode, hit with water and heal their allies in contact.

mech.wanted.khepricorne.resistances.title: Water and air weaknesses
mech.wanted.khepricorne.resistances.summary: The Khepricorne has lower resistances in water (5%) and air (10%).

mech.wanted.khepricorne.allies-de-circon.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.khepricorne.allies-de-circon.summary: Effect common to wanted bosses: -2000 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.title: "Tourment": an MP removal attempt removes invulnerability for 1 turn
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.summary: The Psikopompe is invulnerable for the whole fight. Attempting to remove his MP makes him vulnerable for 1 turn, but he then gains 63 range for 2 turns: since all his damage spells have modifiable range, "Bondage" (normally in contact) can then hit in a line at infinite range.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.expectedStateChange: The Psikopompe loses the invulnerable state and gains 63 range for 2 turns.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.prerequisites.0: An MP removal attempt on the Psikopompe (preferably at range; the guide cites the Pandawa's "Engourdissement").
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.notes.0: Once he is vulnerable and not blocked, get out of his line of sight or out of his lines.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.notes.1: Do not unlock him without focusing him: pointless and dangerous because of the range gain.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Preparation: bring MP removal, preferably at range, and if possible a tank Pandawa with good neutral resistances.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: Only an MP removal attempt removes his invulnerability; the tank is used to block him.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Placement: pick a starting position at range from the Psikopompe.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Bondage" hits in melee for 10% of his remaining HP (about 2000 at full health): avoid having him in melee from turn 1.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Never end your turn next to an ally.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Tourment": at the start of a character's turn, all characters on their adjacent cells take 500 to 700 in a random element.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Send the tank Pandawa into contact with him to block him and cut his line of sight on the others (or block him in a corner with a Cuirboule if he is accompanied).
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.4.position: Tank in contact, other characters at range behind him
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: He can neither push nor teleport and all his spells need line of sight.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Attempt an MP removal on him to make him vulnerable (the tank can use "Engourdissement"), then hit him at range.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: He becomes vulnerable for 1 turn, but gains 63 range for 2 turns.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Once he is vulnerable, if he is not blocked: get out of his line of sight or far enough not to be in line with him.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: With +63 range, "Bondage" is cast in a line at infinite range. Do not make him vulnerable needlessly if you are not focusing him.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.7.action: Before any heal, check that the target does not have the "Tue la cible" effect.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.7.rationale: "Sentence" (size 1 cross) applies this effect for 2 turns, cannot be debuffed: the target is one-shot if healed.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.8.action: When he casts "Retour à l'envoyeur" on himself, debuff him; otherwise hit him only with weapons.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.8.rationale: From turn 2 then every 3 turns, he reflects spells for 1 turn.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.9.action: Start again from step 5 each turn until he dies.

mech.wanted.psikopompe.sentence.title: "Sentence": do not heal the target for 2 turns
mech.wanted.psikopompe.sentence.summary: "Sentence" (size 1 cross area) hits and applies "Tue la cible" for 2 turns, cannot be debuffed: the target dies if it receives any heal at all. Healers must check for this effect before healing.
mech.wanted.psikopompe.sentence.notes.0: Area heal or self-heal on a marked character: instant death.

mech.wanted.psikopompe.tourment-adjacent.title: Never end your turn next to an ally
mech.wanted.psikopompe.tourment-adjacent.summary: At the start of each character's turn, "Tourment" hits (500 to 700, random element) all characters on their adjacent cells. Keep characters apart. All monsters also have +3 range.

mech.wanted.psikopompe.retour-envoyeur.title: "Retour à l'envoyeur": debuff or hit with weapons
mech.wanted.psikopompe.retour-envoyeur.summary: From turn 2 then every 3 turns, he can reflect spells for 1 turn (on himself or on monsters in a cross). Debuff him, or failing that, hit him only with weapons.

mech.wanted.psikopompe.bondage.title: Avoid contact with him while he has a lot of HP
mech.wanted.psikopompe.bondage.summary: "Bondage" hits in contact for 10% of his remaining HP (about 2000 at full health). Stay at range while he is at full strength, pick a distant starting position, or block him with a tank (neutral-resistant Pandawa) or a monster (Cuirboule) since he can neither push nor teleport.

mech.wanted.psikopompe.allies-de-circons.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.psikopompe.allies-de-circons.summary: Effect common to wanted bosses: -2000 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.shushu-debruk-sayl.invulnera.title: "Siphonage élémentaire": push him to exactly 16-19 AP
mech.wanted.shushu-debruk-sayl.invulnera.summary: The Shushu is invulnerable. He only loses this state (2 turns) by casting "Assimilation d'énergies", which costs 16 AP while he only has 11. At the start of his turn, he steals 3 AP (2 turns) from each character or summon within a radius of 3: placing exactly 2 targets in this area brings him to 17 AP. At 20 AP or more, he casts "Mue démoniaque" and heals himself for 100% of his HP.
mech.wanted.shushu-debruk-sayl.invulnera.expectedStateChange: The Shushu casts "Assimilation d'énergies", loses the invulnerable state and 300 power; the characters lose 150 power.
mech.wanted.shushu-debruk-sayl.invulnera.prerequisites.0: Exactly 2 characters or summons within a radius of 3 around the Shushu at the start of his turn.
mech.wanted.shushu-debruk-sayl.invulnera.notes.0: Too many targets in radius 3: 20 AP or more and a heal of 100% of his HP.
mech.wanted.shushu-debruk-sayl.invulnera.notes.1: If he reaches 20 AP, the Insoignable state (or erosion) can prevent the heal.
mech.wanted.shushu-debruk-sayl.invulnera.sequences.0.label: Make the Shushu vulnerable
mech.wanted.shushu-debruk-sayl.invulnera.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Place two summons (preferably) between 1 and 3 range from the Shushu, with no other entity in the area.
mech.wanted.shushu-debruk-sayl.invulnera.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: He steals 3 AP from each: 11 + 6 = 17 AP; the characters keep their AP.
mech.wanted.shushu-debruk-sayl.invulnera.sequences.0.steps.2.action: After the theft, move these summons away or kill them.
mech.wanted.shushu-debruk-sayl.invulnera.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Avoid another AP theft on the next turn that would bring him to 20 AP.
mech.wanted.shushu-debruk-sayl.invulnera.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Hit him during his 2 vulnerable turns.

mech.wanted.shushu-debruk-sayl.dommages-.title: Final damage increasing with the number of characters
mech.wanted.shushu-debruk-sayl.dommages-.summary: At the start of each turn, he gains 2% final damage for 4 turns per character present (summons and companions not counted), stackable: the fight must be short.

mech.wanted.shushu-debruk-sayl.zones.title: Do not line up characters (line and diagonal)
mech.wanted.shushu-debruk-sayl.zones.summary: His two damage spells hit in a size 5 cross and a size 4 diagonal cross: keep characters from being in line or diagonal with each other.

mech.wanted.shushu-debruk-sayl.allies-de.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.shushu-debruk-sayl.allies-de.summary: Effect common to wanted bosses: -1500 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.yechti.invulnerabilite.title: "Goulaf'": he becomes vulnerable by killing a target in contact
mech.wanted.yechti.invulnerabilite.summary: The YeCh'Ti is invulnerable. He only loses it (1 turn) by casting "Goulaf'", which instantly kills a target in contact with him (character or summon), possible from turn 2. When he becomes vulnerable, he heals himself for 800 HP and becomes Enraciné for 1 turn (no more pushing possible). The guide advises offering him a summon.
mech.wanted.yechti.invulnerabilite.expectedStateChange: The YeCh'Ti loses the invulnerable state, heals himself for 800 HP and becomes Enraciné.
mech.wanted.yechti.invulnerabilite.prerequisites.1: A summon (preferably) is in contact with him.
mech.wanted.yechti.invulnerabilite.notes.0: Leaving him in contact with a character: "Goulaf'" kills that character.
mech.wanted.yechti.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.label: Guide's method
mech.wanted.yechti.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Push him back as far as possible from the team (he is Lourd: no carrying).
mech.wanted.yechti.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Place a summon next to him.
mech.wanted.yechti.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: He kills it with "Goulaf'" and becomes vulnerable.
mech.wanted.yechti.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Hit as hard as possible during the vulnerable turn, without being able to push him (Enraciné).
mech.wanted.yechti.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Let him become invulnerable again, then start over.
mech.wanted.yechti.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: Safe method if you cannot kill him in one turn.

mech.wanted.yechti.pesanteur.title: Keep him under Pesanteur to block his teleports
mech.wanted.yechti.pesanteur.summary: Invulnerable or not, he has teleports (5 or 6 cells) to come and kill in contact. The guide recommends applying the Pesanteur state to him and keeping it on until he dies.

mech.wanted.yechti.allies-de-circonstanc.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.yechti.allies-de-circonstanc.summary: Effect common to wanted bosses: -1400 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.hyperscampe.invulnerabilite.title: "Hostilité": occupy 3 blue "Riveteuse" glyphs
mech.wanted.hyperscampe.invulnerabilite.summary: The Hyperscampe is invulnerable. "Riveteuse" places 3 to 4 blue glyphs around its target. Characters who end their turn on a glyph go through the "Grand Frère" then "Petite Sœur" states: when a character in "Petite Sœur" is on a glyph at the start of the Hyperscampe's turn, "Rivet" makes it vulnerable for 1 turn. In practice: 3 characters on 3 different glyphs.
mech.wanted.hyperscampe.invulnerabilite.expectedStateChange: The Hyperscampe loses the invulnerable state at the start of its turn.
mech.wanted.hyperscampe.invulnerabilite.prerequisites.0: At least 3 blue glyphs placed by "Riveteuse".
mech.wanted.hyperscampe.invulnerabilite.prerequisites.1: The Hyperscampe is not in the Pesanteur state.
mech.wanted.hyperscampe.invulnerabilite.notes.0: Characters on a glyph become Indéplaçable for 1 turn, are healed for 200 HP and lose 200 power for 2 turns.
mech.wanted.hyperscampe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.label: Make the Hyperscampe vulnerable
mech.wanted.hyperscampe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Place characters away from walls and empty cells (radius 2).
mech.wanted.hyperscampe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: Otherwise it may place fewer than 3 glyphs and the unlock fails that turn.
mech.wanted.hyperscampe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.2.action: A first character ends their turn on a glyph (the others receive "Grand Frère").
mech.wanted.hyperscampe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.3.action: A second "Grand Frère" character ends their turn on another glyph (the other "Grand Frère" characters switch to "Petite Sœur").
mech.wanted.hyperscampe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.4.action: A "Petite Sœur" character ends their turn on a third glyph.
mech.wanted.hyperscampe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: At the start of the Hyperscampe's turn, "Rivet" removes its invulnerability.
mech.wanted.hyperscampe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Repeat every turn, even while it is vulnerable.
mech.wanted.hyperscampe.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: So that it stays vulnerable on the next turn.

mech.wanted.hyperscampe.pesanteur.title: Never apply the Pesanteur state to it
mech.wanted.hyperscampe.pesanteur.summary: Under Pesanteur, the Hyperscampe casts neither "Riveteuse" nor "Rivet"; if it receives Pesanteur while vulnerable, it immediately becomes invulnerable again.

mech.wanted.hyperscampe.orphelinat.title: "Orphelinat": fewer glyphs to occupy after deaths
mech.wanted.hyperscampe.orphelinat.summary: When a first ally dies, all characters gain "Grand Frère" (infinite): 2 characters on glyphs are enough. When a second dies, all switch to "Petite Sœur" (infinite): just one is enough. The guide suggests sacrificing companions if the team has fewer than 8 members.

mech.wanted.hyperscampe.percussion.title: "Percussion": erosion on pushback damage
mech.wanted.hyperscampe.percussion.summary: "Percussion" pulls, hits and pushes back 5 cells, and applies a non-debuffable poison of 50% erosion (1 turn, stackable) triggered on each pushback damage taken in melee.

mech.wanted.hyperscampe.allies-de-circon.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.hyperscampe.allies-de-circon.summary: Effect common to wanted bosses: -2000 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with it (no penalty via the legendary hunt). Alone in the fight, it has no penalty.

mech.wanted.mekamouth.invulnerabilite.title: "Potentiomètre": end its turn in the blue cross glyph ("Surtension")
mech.wanted.mekamouth.invulnerabilite.summary: Mekamouth is invulnerable. It becomes vulnerable for 1 turn if it ends its turn in a size 1 blue cross glyph placed by "Surtension" (permanent glyph, a new one every 3 turns). Guide's method: block it in a corner between two walls and two static summons; it then casts its glyphs on those summons and ends its turns in the glyph.
mech.wanted.mekamouth.invulnerabilite.prerequisites.0: Mekamouth ends its turn in a "Surtension" glyph.
mech.wanted.mekamouth.invulnerabilite.notes.0: The cawotte glyphs heal it for 3% of its max HP per turn each: prefer other static summons, and bring erosion.
mech.wanted.mekamouth.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.label: Blocking method
mech.wanted.mekamouth.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Block it in a corner between two walls and two static summons (cawotte, tree, bombs, bamboo…).
mech.wanted.mekamouth.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: It places its glyphs on the summons in contact with it and stays in the blue glyph.
mech.wanted.mekamouth.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Do not end your turn in line with it.
mech.wanted.mekamouth.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Its glyphs are cast in a line (no line of sight needed): it will only target the summons.
mech.wanted.mekamouth.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Spahunglif" (6-turn cooldown) kills a summon blocking it.

mech.wanted.mekamouth.malus-permanents.title: Permanent penalties: -2 AP and poison on MP used
mech.wanted.mekamouth.malus-permanents.summary: From the start, "Potentiomètre" removes 2 AP from all characters for the whole fight and applies a water poison triggered on each MP used: move as little as possible.
mech.wanted.mekamouth.malus-permanents.unknownAspects.0: Contradictory poison value: 15 HP per MP (effect description) or 60 (tactical tips).

mech.wanted.mekamouth.glyphes.title: Glyphs: bonuses for monsters, penalties for the team
mech.wanted.mekamouth.glyphes.summary: Almost all its spells are glyphs cast in a line, without line of sight: red (fire hit / heals monsters), green (-20% resistances and Pesanteur / +20% for monsters), blue radius 2 (erosion and poison / +25% vitality for monsters), invisible glyph (-100 damage / +100 for monsters).

mech.wanted.mekamouth.resistances.title: Water and air weaknesses
mech.wanted.mekamouth.resistances.summary: Mekamouth is weak to water and air, with high resistances elsewhere (especially fire).

mech.wanted.mekamouth.allies-de-circonst.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.mekamouth.allies-de-circonst.summary: Effect common to wanted bosses: -2000 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with it. Alone in the fight, it has no penalty.

mech.wanted.panteroz.reduction-distance.title: "Répression": immune at range, hit in melee
mech.wanted.panteroz.reduction-distance.summary: Pantèroz is not invulnerable, but she reduces the damage taken at range by 666 (actual reduction of 35298 per hit) for the whole fight: only melee attacks hurt her.

mech.wanted.panteroz.silence.title: Start of her turn: Silencieux and summons killed within a radius of 2
mech.wanted.panteroz.silence.summary: At the start of each of her turns, she makes characters within a radius of 2 Silencieux (no spells or weapon, debuffable) for 1 turn and kills summons in that radius. Be more than 2 range away when she starts her turn, ideally more than 8 range (7 MP + melee) to avoid her earth hit in contact.
mech.wanted.panteroz.silence.sequences.0.label: Recommended cycle
mech.wanted.panteroz.silence.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Hit in contact during her team's turn.
mech.wanted.panteroz.silence.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Move away (more than 2 range, ideally more than 8 range) before the start of her turn.

mech.wanted.panteroz.erosion.title: Don't erode him ("Rayondulé")
mech.wanted.panteroz.erosion.summary: "Rayondulé" hits for 50% of his eroded HP (plus a fire area): the guide advises against eroding him.

mech.wanted.sam-sagaz.invulnerabilite.title: "Garde né": kill Bolesh next to Sam
mech.wanted.sam-sagaz.invulnerabilite.summary: Sam Sagaz is invulnerable. He summons "Bolesh" (200 HP, Insoignable, loses 50 HP at the end of each turn, so it dies on its own in 4 turns; can be re-summoned every 4 turns). Killing Bolesh while it is on a cell adjacent to Sam makes Sam vulnerable for 2 turns.
mech.wanted.sam-sagaz.invulnerabilite.expectedStateChange: Sam Sagaz loses the Invulnerable state.
mech.wanted.sam-sagaz.invulnerabilite.prerequisites.0: Bolesh is in play, on a cell adjacent to Sam Sagaz.
mech.wanted.sam-sagaz.invulnerabilite.notes.0: Killing Bolesh away from Sam: no effect, and you have to wait for the re-summon (4 turns).
mech.wanted.sam-sagaz.invulnerabilite.unknownAspects.0: The guide doesn't say whether Bolesh dying on its own (HP loss) next to Sam counts.
mech.wanted.sam-sagaz.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.label: Make Sam vulnerable
mech.wanted.sam-sagaz.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Bring Bolesh into contact with Sam (or wait until it is).

mech.wanted.sam-sagaz.distance.title: Stay more than 6 range away
mech.wanted.sam-sagaz.distance.summary: Sam only hits in melee, or in an area around himself only if he has a target in contact: staying more than 6 range away (5 MP + melee) avoids his damage.

mech.wanted.sam-sagaz.allies-de-circonst.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.sam-sagaz.allies-de-circonst.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -40 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.takomako.invulnerabilite.title: "Mipieuvre Mirequin": invulnerable if nobody is within a radius of 5 at the start of his turn
mech.wanted.takomako.invulnerabilite.summary: Takomako is not invulnerable by default, but becomes so for 1 turn if no character is within a radius of 5 around him at the start of his turn. Always keep at least one character (preferably a tank) at 5 range or less.
mech.wanted.takomako.invulnerabilite.prerequisites.0: At least one character within a radius of 5 around Takomako at the start of his turn.
mech.wanted.takomako.invulnerabilite.notes.0: Nobody within radius 5 at the start of his turn: invulnerable for 1 turn.
mech.wanted.takomako.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.takomako.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Assign a character (preferably a tank or a character who doesn't hit) who will always be at 5 range or less from Takomako at the start of his turn.
mech.wanted.takomako.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.1.position: Within a radius of 5 around Takomako
mech.wanted.takomako.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Mipieuvre Mirequin": if he has no character within a radius of 5 at the start of his turn, he becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn.
mech.wanted.takomako.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Place the other characters far from him and/or behind obstacles, out of his lines.
mech.wanted.takomako.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Makomak" (in line, with line of sight, up to 10 range) applies Pacifiste and Insoignable, to up to two characters per turn.
mech.wanted.takomako.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Remove all his MP at once with a spell that puts them in the negative (Enutrof's "Retraite Anticipée", Iop's "Duel").
mech.wanted.takomako.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Takotak" hits based on the proportion of MP he has left; he regains 1 MP at the start of his turn, hence the need for negative MP.
mech.wanted.takomako.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: He gains 1 MP at the start of each turn (up to +10), which increases Takotak's power and makes it harder to stay out of his line of sight.
mech.wanted.takomako.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Option: use non-static summons to draw his attention.
mech.wanted.takomako.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: He prefers hitting summons he can kill, unless characters are low on health or have low neutral resistance.
mech.wanted.takomako.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Watch everyone's Folie level and hide a character whose level gets too high for a few turns.
mech.wanted.takomako.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: Folie 2 reflects your damage onto allies within 2 range, Folie 4 reduces healing received, Folie 6 increases damage taken, Folie 10 kills. You lose one level at the start of each of your own turns.

mech.wanted.takomako.takotak.title: "Takotak": the more MP he keeps, the harder he hits
mech.wanted.takomako.takotak.summary: He gains 1 MP at the start of each turn (up to +10). His only damage spell (10 range, no line of sight) hits in neutral based on the proportion of MP he has left. The guide advises killing him fast and removing all his MP at once with an effect that puts them in the negative (Retraite Anticipée, Duel), since he regains 1 MP at the start of his turn.
mech.wanted.takomako.takotak.unknownAspects.0: Maximum damage is stated differently: about 2 500 (quick overview) or up to 2000 (spell description).

mech.wanted.takomako.folie.title: "FOLIE !" states (1 to 10): death at 10
mech.wanted.takomako.folie.summary: Some spells (Takotak and spells of monsters from the area) add a Folie level; you lose one at the start of each of your turns. Penalties stack: Folie 2 reflects the damage of your spells onto allies within 2 range, Folie 4 reduces healing received, Folie 6 increases damage taken, Folie 10 kills. Hide a character whose level is too high for a few turns.
mech.wanted.takomako.folie.unknownAspects.0: The Folie 6 value is written "Dommage Subis x100%" in the guide, which looks like a typo.

mech.wanted.takomako.makomak.title: Hide from "Makomak" (Pacifiste and Insoignable)
mech.wanted.takomako.makomak.summary: "Makomak" applies Pacifiste and Insoignable (up to two characters per turn), but is cast in line with line of sight: stay far away and/or behind obstacles, while keeping one character at 5 range.

mech.wanted.takomako.allies-de-circonsta.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.takomako.allies-de-circonsta.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -2000 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.atcham.chi-fou-mi.title: "Chi fou mi": rock-paper-scissors
mech.wanted.atcham.chi-fou-mi.summary: No invulnerability. At the start of each of Fou's turns, each character randomly receives the Pierre, Feuille or Ciseaux state and must hit the monster their state beats: Pierre → Fou, Feuille → Chi, Ciseaux → Mi. Damage dealt to the correct monster is also applied to the other two. Getting it wrong makes the character Pacifiste for 3 turns (cannot be debuffed) and reflects 300% of the damage dealt back to them. When one of the three dies, the other two die too.
mech.wanted.atcham.chi-fou-mi.notes.0: Wrong target: Pacifiste for 3 turns and 300% of the damage reflected onto the character, with no splitting.
mech.wanted.atcham.chi-fou-mi.notes.1: Each correct hit gives a 1-turn bonus to the other two monsters (Chi: 3 MP; Fou: 50% critical; Mi: 3 range and 50 dodge), once per monster hit.
mech.wanted.atcham.chi-fou-mi.sequences.0.label: Choose the target according to your state
mech.wanted.atcham.chi-fou-mi.sequences.0.steps.1.action: With the Pierre state: hit Fou.
mech.wanted.atcham.chi-fou-mi.sequences.0.steps.1.when: The character has the Pierre state.
mech.wanted.atcham.chi-fou-mi.sequences.0.steps.2.action: With the Feuille state: hit Chi.
mech.wanted.atcham.chi-fou-mi.sequences.0.steps.2.when: The character has the Feuille state.
mech.wanted.atcham.chi-fou-mi.sequences.0.steps.3.action: With the Ciseaux state: hit Mi.
mech.wanted.atcham.chi-fou-mi.sequences.0.steps.3.when: The character has the Ciseaux state.

mech.wanted.atcham.distances.title: Avoid Chi in melee and Fou at short range
mech.wanted.atcham.distances.summary: Chi hits very hard in melee, Fou very hard on criticals up to 3 range. Stay more than 4 range from Chi and more than 9 range from Fou; or only hit Fou (Pierre characters) so you never give him a critical bonus.

mech.wanted.atcham.allies-de-circonstanc.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.atcham.allies-de-circonstanc.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -2000 vitality (infinite) per monster present with him (no penalty via the legendary hunt). Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.buldalazred.glyphe-noir.title: Traps and black glyph: one-shot when starting or ending your turn in it
mech.wanted.buldalazred.glyphe-noir.summary: No invulnerability. At the start of each turn, he pulls enemies in his line of sight 3 cells and places an invisible black glyph of radius 2 (its displayed position around him is misleading). He also places up to 2 1-cell traps per turn: triggering one pulls the whole team 3 cells towards him, reveals the black glyph and gives him 100 power (infinite, stackable). Starting or ending your turn in the black glyph kills the character.
mech.wanted.buldalazred.glyphe-noir.notes.0: A character who triggers the trap at the end of their movement risks being pulled into the glyph with no MP left.
mech.wanted.buldalazred.glyphe-noir.sequences.0.label: Guide tips
mech.wanted.buldalazred.glyphe-noir.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Limit movement so you don't trigger a trap.
mech.wanted.buldalazred.glyphe-noir.sequences.0.steps.2.action: End your turns with at least 3 MP in reserve.
mech.wanted.buldalazred.glyphe-noir.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Lets you leave a radius-2 glyph even from its center.
mech.wanted.buldalazred.glyphe-noir.sequences.0.steps.3.action: If the glyph appears, get the characters inside it out before they start their turn.
mech.wanted.buldalazred.glyphe-noir.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Protect yourself from pulls (Indéplaçable, Inébranlable, Enraciné: Détermination, Stabilisation, Glyphe Gravitationnel…) or hide behind obstacles.

mech.wanted.buldalazred.allies-de-circon.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.buldalazred.allies-de-circon.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -2000 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.ganos.seuils-saisons.title: Thresholds at 70% and 30%: season change
mech.wanted.ganos.seuils-saisons.summary: No permanent invulnerability. Ganos starts in the state of the current season (Naissance, Chasse or Repos) and moves to the next season (Naissance > Chasse > Repos) at 70% then 30% of his HP, which changes his three spells. When a threshold is reached, he can no longer be hit until the start of his next turn.
mech.wanted.ganos.seuils-saisons.sequences.0.label: Adapt to the season
mech.wanted.ganos.seuils-saisons.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Season of Births: beware of "Matatak" when he has lost a lot of HP.
mech.wanted.ganos.seuils-saisons.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Season of the Hunt: stay at range, he only hits in melee.
mech.wanted.ganos.seuils-saisons.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Season of Rest: reduce his range.

mech.wanted.ganos.ganorage.title: "Ganorage": growing bonuses for 10 turns
mech.wanted.ganos.ganorage.summary: The Ganorage state increases by 1 each turn (up to 10, then Ganorage Ultime) and gives growing bonuses for 1 turn (final damage, MP, lock, dodge, vitality). The guide advises killing him as fast as possible.
mech.wanted.ganos.ganorage.unknownAspects.0: The guide says the bonuses stop on turn 11 but also that the fight gets more dangerous over time; the discrepancy isn't explained.

mech.wanted.ganos.poussee.title: Don't stay in line: 20-cell push
mech.wanted.ganos.poussee.summary: At the start of each turn, Ganos pushes the nearest character or summon in line with him back 20 cells. Avoid being aligned, or place a summon closer to him on the same line so it is targeted instead.

mech.wanted.ganos.allies-de-circonstance.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.ganos.allies-de-circonstance.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -2000 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.grand-kongoku.cocolune.title: Cocolune: pull then Pacifiste in line of sight
mech.wanted.grand-kongoku.cocolune.summary: No invulnerability. From his first turn, he summons a Cocolune (15 000 HP, 0 MP, Indéplaçable), re-summoned 1 turn after it dies. While it is present, characters are Pesanteur and the Kongoku is "Super Singe". At the start of its turn, it pulls characters 10 cells then makes those in its line of sight Pacifiste; if the Kongoku is in its line of sight, he gains 500 power and 5000 vitality (infinite).
mech.wanted.grand-kongoku.cocolune.notes.0: Killing the Cocolune: effects removed for 1 turn only.
mech.wanted.grand-kongoku.cocolune.notes.1: The pull happens before the Pacifiste: anticipate your position after the pull.
mech.wanted.grand-kongoku.cocolune.sequences.0.label: Guide tips
mech.wanted.grand-kongoku.cocolune.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Surround the Cocolune with summons (preferably static ones).
mech.wanted.grand-kongoku.cocolune.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: Blocks its line of sight on the team and on the Kongoku.
mech.wanted.grand-kongoku.cocolune.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Protect yourself from movement effects (Inébranlable, Enraciné, Indéplaçable; the Feca's Glyphe Gravitationnel is mentioned).
mech.wanted.grand-kongoku.cocolune.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Avoids being pulled into its line of sight and the Kongoku's 20-cell pushes.
mech.wanted.grand-kongoku.cocolune.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Don't waste time killing the Cocolune; focus the Grand Kongoku.

mech.wanted.grand-kongoku.resistances.title: Water and air weaknesses
mech.wanted.grand-kongoku.resistances.summary: The Grand Kongoku has -10% water resistance and -5% air.

mech.wanted.grand-kongoku.allies-de-circ.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.grand-kongoku.allies-de-circ.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -2000 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.reduction-d.title: 75% reduction of ranged damage
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.reduction-d.summary: No invulnerability, but she reduces ranged damage taken by 75% for the whole fight: hit her in melee, or at range with a lot of erosion. She is Intaclable and Pesanteur; characters are Pesanteur for the whole fight.
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.reduction-d.notes.0: To reach her despite the MP reductions: a Pandawa carrying her towards the team, or spells that pull towards a monster (Déferlement, Reuche).
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.reduction-d.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.reduction-d.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Bring characters who hit with fire, earth or neutral.
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.reduction-d.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: 35% water and air resistance, versus 10% fire, 15% earth and 15% neutral.
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.reduction-d.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Space characters out and don't leave them aligned.
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.reduction-d.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Carroyage" hits in a size-7 line and pushes back 6 cells (heavy push damage); "Mastaba" removes 4 MP in a radius-2 circle up to 12 range.
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.reduction-d.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Hit her in melee; if playing at range, use as much erosion as possible.
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.reduction-d.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: She reduces ranged damage taken by 75% for the whole fight.
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.reduction-d.sequences.0.steps.4.action: To reach melee despite lost MP, use a Pandawa who throws her towards the team, or spells that pull towards a monster (Iop's "Déferlement", Masqueraider's "Reuche").
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.reduction-d.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: She removes a lot of MP and everyone is Pesanteur: no teleporting or swapping places.
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.reduction-d.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Before bringing her below 50% of her vitality, charge your spells and buff up as much as possible.
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.reduction-d.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: Below 50%, on her next turn she summons 3 Images Miroir (7500 HP) that use her spells, for the rest of the fight.
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.reduction-d.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Ignore the Images Miroir and focus all damage on Braïdeur to finish her before they play again.
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.reduction-d.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: A killed Image is re-summoned on Braïdeur's next turn.

mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.images-miro.title: Below 50%: 3 permanent Images Miroir
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.images-miro.summary: When she drops below 50% of her maximum vitality, on her next turn she summons 3 Images Miroir that use her spells (without her reduction or her states) and are re-summoned as soon as they die. Buff up as much as possible before crossing this threshold, then ignore the Images and finish her quickly.
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.images-miro.notes.0: Killing the Images Miroir: they come back on Braïdeur's next turn.

mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.espacement.title: Space characters out and avoid lines
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.espacement.summary: One spell hits in a line at long range with a 6-cell push (heavy push damage) and another removes a lot of MP in a radius-2 circle: don't align characters and keep them spaced out.

mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.resistances.title: Resistant to water and air
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.resistances.summary: 35% water and air resistance; less in fire (10%), earth (15%) and neutral (15%).

mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.allies-de-c.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.fantome-braideur.allies-de-c.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -2000 vitality (infinite) per monster present with her. Alone in the fight, she has no penalty.

mech.wanted.sicogne.fuite-ratee.title: Failed escape from his contact: one-shot of all characters in contact
mech.wanted.sicogne.fuite-ratee.summary: No invulnerability. If a character tries to leave his contact and is locked (AP/MP loss), Sicogne kills that character and everyone in contact with them. He increases his lock and reduces characters' dodge to cause this failure.
mech.wanted.sicogne.fuite-ratee.notes.0: Trying to escape without being sure of a 100% escape.
mech.wanted.sicogne.fuite-ratee.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.sicogne.fuite-ratee.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Agression" (up to 10 range without line of sight, normally every turn) kills every summon on the map.
mech.wanted.sicogne.fuite-ratee.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Stay at a distance from Sicogne.
mech.wanted.sicogne.fuite-ratee.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Annihilation" hits for 1000 earth up to 3 range without line of sight, and staying far away avoids being locked in his contact.
mech.wanted.sicogne.fuite-ratee.sequences.0.steps.3.action: If he comes into contact, never try to escape unless the escape is 100% guaranteed.
mech.wanted.sicogne.fuite-ratee.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: A failed escape (AP or MP loss) kills the character and everyone in contact with them. He buffs his lock and applies dodge penalties to cause this failure.
mech.wanted.sicogne.fuite-ratee.sequences.0.steps.4.action: If you have to push, pull, teleport or swap places with him, do it as the very last action of your turn.
mech.wanted.sicogne.fuite-ratee.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: These actions immediately end the character's turn.
mech.wanted.sicogne.fuite-ratee.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Choose carefully which blue glyphs you walk through; Sicogne's ends your turn.
mech.wanted.sicogne.fuite-ratee.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: Each monster places a 1-cell glyph per turn: entering it swaps places with that monster and gives a bonus to both (Sicogne: +400 power but end of turn).
mech.wanted.sicogne.fuite-ratee.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Focus him first and kill him quickly, exploiting his fire weakness.
mech.wanted.sicogne.fuite-ratee.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: He deals a lot of damage, has no invulnerability and has -5% in fire.

mech.wanted.sicogne.deplacement-fin-de-t.title: Moving him ends your turn
mech.wanted.sicogne.deplacement-fin-de-t.summary: Pushing, pulling, teleporting Sicogne or swapping places with him immediately ends the character's turn: do it as your very last action.

mech.wanted.sicogne.glyphes-bleus.title: Monsters' blue swap glyphs
mech.wanted.sicogne.glyphes-bleus.summary: Each monster places a 1-cell blue glyph per turn; walking through it swaps places with that monster and gives a bonus to both depending on the monster. For Sicogne's glyph: +400 power for both, but the character's turn ends.

mech.wanted.sicogne.invocations.title: Summons are useless ("Agression")
mech.wanted.sicogne.invocations.summary: "Agression" (up to 10 range without line of sight) kills every summon on the map; he can normally cast it every turn.

mech.wanted.sicogne.allies-de-circonstan.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.sicogne.allies-de-circonstan.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -2000 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.voldelor.susceptibilite.title: "Susceptibilité": Marque des Mangelors on the first attacker
mech.wanted.voldelor.susceptibilite.summary: No invulnerability. As soon as he is hit, Voldelor and the first character who hit him receive the Marque des Mangelors (1 turn). His spells then gain an effect: "Armada Cadavra" kills the marked character, "Magitation" swaps places with them at infinite range, "Sort Scellé" adds 30% eroded HP.
mech.wanted.voldelor.susceptibilite.notes.0: Don't stay grouped: "Armada Cadavra" hits in an area and heals him through life steal; he can end up in the middle of the group via the swap with the marked character.
mech.wanted.voldelor.susceptibilite.sequences.0.label: Neutralize the mark
mech.wanted.voldelor.susceptibilite.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Kill the accompanying monsters first without ever touching Voldelor.
mech.wanted.voldelor.susceptibilite.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Move the marked character more than 9 range away before Voldelor's turn (5 MP + 4 spell range).
mech.wanted.voldelor.susceptibilite.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Or have a Pandawa carry the marked character when Voldelor plays.
mech.wanted.voldelor.susceptibilite.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: He then can neither kill them nor swap places with them.

mech.wanted.voldelor.allies-de-circonsta.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.voldelor.allies-de-circonsta.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -2000 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.mouchame.doubles.title: 7 doubles that share damage: hit with area spells
mech.wanted.mouchame.doubles.summary: No invulnerability. From the start, the Mouchâme summons 7 doubles (5000 HP each); all 8 share all damage. The guide advises leaving them grouped and using area spells: a hit on a single one is divided by 8, an area hit deals full damage to each one.
mech.wanted.mouchame.doubles.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.mouchame.doubles.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Start of the fight: stay more than 7 range from the Mouchâmes.
mech.wanted.mouchame.doubles.sequences.0.steps.1.position: More than 7 range from the group
mech.wanted.mouchame.doubles.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: Their only spell, "Herd", is cast in melee (6 base MP + melee); multiplied by 8 Mouchâmes, it becomes dangerous.
mech.wanted.mouchame.doubles.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Leave the Mouchâmes grouped and hit them with area spells.
mech.wanted.mouchame.doubles.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: The 8 Mouchâmes (7 doubles with 5000 HP + the original) share damage: a hit on a single one is divided by 8, an area hit deals full damage to each one.
mech.wanted.mouchame.doubles.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Stay out of their contact while they have more than 50% vitality.
mech.wanted.mouchame.doubles.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: Above 50%, they gain 50 power (infinite, stackable) per line of direct damage received: they hit harder and harder.
mech.wanted.mouchame.doubles.sequences.0.steps.4.action: As soon as a Mouchâme drops below 50%, finish the fight as fast as possible or stay well away.
mech.wanted.mouchame.doubles.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: Below 50%, "Herd" adds an effect that kills the target in 3 turns.

mech.wanted.mouchame.seuil-50.title: Above / below 50% vitality
mech.wanted.mouchame.seuil-50.summary: Above 50% of their vitality, the Mouchâmes gain 50 power (infinite, stackable) per line of direct damage received. Below it, their melee spell "Herd" adds "Kills the target in 3 turns". Stay more than 7 range away (6 MP + melee) and finish the fight quickly once the threshold is passed.

mech.wanted.guerrier-du-ko.etoile-du-mat.title: "Étoile du matin": one-shot in the lines and diagonals of the target hit
mech.wanted.guerrier-du-ko.etoile-du-mat.summary: No invulnerability. The Guerrier and his allies kill every character standing in the lines and diagonals of the enemy being hit. Before each attack, check that neither you nor an ally is aligned (line or diagonal) with the target; the guide advises playing at range and sending the target far away (Pandawa).
mech.wanted.guerrier-du-ko.etoile-du-mat.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.guerrier-du-ko.etoile-du-mat.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Play at range and group the team on one side of the map.
mech.wanted.guerrier-du-ko.etoile-du-mat.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: The diagonals of the monster being hit then pass far from the team: you only have to avoid being in line with it.
mech.wanted.guerrier-du-ko.etoile-du-mat.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Before each attack, check that neither you nor an ally is in the target's lines or diagonals.
mech.wanted.guerrier-du-ko.etoile-du-mat.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Étoile du matin": the Guerrier and his allies kill every character in the lines and diagonals of the enemy taking damage.
mech.wanted.guerrier-du-ko.etoile-du-mat.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Use a Pandawa to throw the focused monster away from the group.
mech.wanted.guerrier-du-ko.etoile-du-mat.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: Guide tip to make the diagonals less restrictive.
mech.wanted.guerrier-du-ko.etoile-du-mat.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Never let a character drop to 50% of their maximum vitality or less.
mech.wanted.guerrier-du-ko.etoile-du-mat.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: "Carnageddon" (every turn, infinite-size cross, propagated by aligned monsters) kills characters at 50% or less.
mech.wanted.guerrier-du-ko.etoile-du-mat.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Each turn, spot who has "Massacre à retardement" and end their turn with no monster within a radius of 6.
mech.wanted.guerrier-du-ko.etoile-du-mat.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: That character is one-shot if they have an enemy within a radius of 6 at the end of their turn.

mech.wanted.guerrier-du-ko.seuil-50-pv.title: Never drop to 50% HP or less
mech.wanted.guerrier-du-ko.seuil-50-pv.summary: Each turn, a spell hits characters in his lines (and spreads to the lines of monsters aligned with him) and kills those at 50% or less of their maximum vitality.

mech.wanted.guerrier-du-ko.massacre.title: "Massacre à retardement": no monster within 6 cells at the end of the turn
mech.wanted.guerrier-du-ko.massacre.summary: Each turn, one character receives "Massacre à retardement": they die if they have a monster within a radius of 6 at the end of their turn.

mech.wanted.guerrier-du-ko.allies-de-cir.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.guerrier-du-ko.allies-de-cir.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -1500 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.oeuf-de-la-mor.title: Œuf de la Mort: neither in line nor within 4 cells
mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.oeuf-de-la-mor.summary: No invulnerability for the Docteur. He summons invulnerable Œufs de la Mort that pull characters in their lines into contact, then explode on their second turn, killing every character within a radius of 4. He also summons unstable Gobus that explode with a random effect (radius 2).
mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.oeuf-de-la-mor.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.oeuf-de-la-mor.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Stay out of Docteur Eggob's lines.
mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.oeuf-de-la-mor.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Rayon Émeraude" is cast only in line at infinite range: 400 fire in a size-3 cross, Insoignable for 2 turns and a poison of 15% of HP.
mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.oeuf-de-la-mor.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Remove as many of his MP as possible, or have a tank character lock him.
mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.oeuf-de-la-mor.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: With his 5 MP he easily catches someone in line; locked by a tank = he only casts the spell on that character.
mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.oeuf-de-la-mor.sequences.0.steps.3.action: As soon as an Œuf de la Mort appears, never stay in line with it.
mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.oeuf-de-la-mor.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: The Œuf (5000 HP, Invulnerable) pulls every character in its lines into contact.
mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.oeuf-de-la-mor.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Leave the radius of 4 around the Œuf before it explodes.
mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.oeuf-de-la-mor.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: It explodes on its second turn and kills every character within a radius of 4. The Œuf doesn't lock.
mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.oeuf-de-la-mor.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Beware of unstable Gobus, even when you kill them yourself.
mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.oeuf-de-la-mor.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: They explode on their second turn (or when they die) with a random effect in a radius-2 circle: damage, debuff, 50% erosion, -4 MP or -8 range.
mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.oeuf-de-la-mor.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Debuff the ally he makes invulnerable with "Robotisation" if needed.
mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.oeuf-de-la-mor.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: Robotisation makes an ally Invulnerable for 1 turn (debuffable) with +100 AP/MP dodge and +300 damage.

mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.insoignable.title: Avoid his lines (Insoignable, cannot be debuffed)
mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.insoignable.summary: His damage spell, cast only in line (infinite range, no line of sight), poisons and applies Insoignable for 2 turns (cannot be debuffed). Remove his MP or have a tank lock him so he only targets that character.
mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.insoignable.notes.0: He can make one of his allies invulnerable for 1 turn.

mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.allies-de-circ.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.docteur-eggob.allies-de-circ.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -1700 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.flasho.reinitialisation.title: Reset on the 7th turn: kill him before
mech.wanted.flasho.reinitialisation.summary: No invulnerability. On the 7th turn, Flasho recovers all his HP, returns to his starting position, removes all buffs/debuffs, kills all summons and removes 4 AP for 2 turns from enemies. The guide states that this effect happens even if Flasho has been eliminated.
mech.wanted.flasho.reinitialisation.prerequisites.0: Kill him before he plays his 7th turn.
mech.wanted.flasho.reinitialisation.unknownAspects.0: The guide doesn't say what the reset does if Flasho is already dead (end of fight or return to play).
mech.wanted.flasho.reinitialisation.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.flasho.reinitialisation.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Goal: kill Flasho before he plays his 7th turn.
mech.wanted.flasho.reinitialisation.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: On turn 7, he heals himself (about 20 000 HP), returns to his starting position, debuffs everyone, kills all summons and removes 4 AP for 2 turns from enemies, even if he has been eliminated.
mech.wanted.flasho.reinitialisation.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Don't attempt any AP or MP reduction and don't push him.
mech.wanted.flasho.reinitialisation.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: MP reduction or push: +2 MP for 2 turns; AP reduction: +300 damage for 2 turns.
mech.wanted.flasho.reinitialisation.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Don't attack him with a weapon in close combat; ranged weapons (Staff, Axe, Shovel, Hammer, Scythe) remain usable without standing next to him.
mech.wanted.flasho.reinitialisation.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: He dodges 100% of melee weapon attacks by stepping back one cell.
mech.wanted.flasho.reinitialisation.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Watch out for the Pacifiste state on him.
mech.wanted.flasho.reinitialisation.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: If he is Pacifiste at the start of his turn, he can cast "Amende": he removes the state, debuffs all characters, deals 800 neutral life steal to them and heals his allies for 1200 HP.
mech.wanted.flasho.reinitialisation.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Watch out for static summons (Cawotte, Tree).
mech.wanted.flasho.reinitialisation.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: "Vibration moléculaire" makes him swap places with a static summon up to 20 range and deals 1400 fire life steal to it.

mech.wanted.flasho.reactions.title: Don't push him, don't reduce his AP/MP, don't attack him with a weapon in close combat
mech.wanted.flasho.reactions.summary: Any MP reduction attempt or push gives him 2 MP (2 turns); any AP reduction attempt gives him 300 damage (2 turns); he dodges 100% of melee weapon attacks by stepping back one cell (ranged weapons remain usable).

mech.wanted.flasho.amende.title: Pacifiste at the start of his turn: "Amende"
mech.wanted.flasho.amende.summary: If he is Pacifiste at the start of his turn, he can cast "Amende": he removes the state, debuffs all characters, deals 800 neutral life steal to them and heals his allies for 1200 HP.
mech.wanted.flasho.amende.notes.0: Making him Pacifiste triggers this counterattack.

mech.wanted.flasho.allies-de-circonstanc.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.flasho.allies-de-circonstanc.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -1700 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.predagob.invisibilite.title: Invisible at the start of each turn: reveal him by hitting him
mech.wanted.predagob.invisibilite.summary: No invulnerability, but Predagob becomes invisible again at the start of each of his turns; dealing damage to him makes him visible until his next turn. The guide advises area spells to find him, then moving him to exactly 10 range from a character: with 10 MP and melee-only attacks, he will come into contact with that character.
mech.wanted.predagob.invisibilite.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.predagob.invisibilite.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Preparation: avoid characters who only hit in earth.
mech.wanted.predagob.invisibilite.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: He kills summons in one hit while healing himself ("Moâ chasser bestioles !") and those in contact with him at the start of his turn die.
mech.wanted.predagob.invisibilite.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Use area spells to find and hit him.
mech.wanted.predagob.invisibilite.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: He is invisible at the start of each of his turns; dealing damage to him makes him visible until his next turn.
mech.wanted.predagob.invisibilite.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Once he is visible, move him to exactly 10 range from a character.
mech.wanted.predagob.invisibilite.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: With 10 MP and melee-only attacks, he will come into contact with that character, which lets you find him again.
mech.wanted.predagob.invisibilite.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Watch out for lines at 1-2 range from him at the start of his turn.
mech.wanted.predagob.invisibilite.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: He then pushes back 4 cells everything in line at 1 or 2 range. Each character in contact with him at that moment reduces his final damage by 10% for 1 turn.
mech.wanted.predagob.invisibilite.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Each turn, spot the carrier of "Mine Goblitérante": they must end their turn more than 3 range from the others.
mech.wanted.predagob.invisibilite.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: At the end of their turn, the mine hits for 750 fire and removes 3 AP for 2 turns from them and everyone within a radius of 3.
mech.wanted.predagob.invisibilite.sequences.0.steps.7.rationale: He becomes invisible again at the start of each of his turns.

mech.wanted.predagob.mine.title: "Mine Goblitérante": isolate the marked character
mech.wanted.predagob.mine.summary: Each turn, one character receives "Mine Goblitérante", which triggers at the end of their turn: fire damage and AP reduction on them and everyone within a radius of 3. That character must end more than 3 range from the others.

mech.wanted.predagob.debut-de-tour.title: Start of his turn: reduction per contact, summons killed, push
mech.wanted.predagob.debut-de-tour.summary: At the start of his turn, his final damage is reduced by 10% per character and 15% per summon in contact with him, but summons in contact with him die. He also pushes back everything in line at 1-2 range. The guide advises against summoning (he kills them and heals himself).

mech.wanted.predagob.resistances.title: Very resistant to earth and neutral

mech.wanted.predagob.allies-de-circonsta.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.predagob.allies-de-circonsta.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -1700 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.viti-glourson.resistances-ad.title: +30% resistance in the element hit, per damage line
mech.wanted.viti-glourson.resistances-ad.summary: No invulnerability. Each damage line gives him 30% resistance in the element used and 150 of the matching characteristic for 2 turns (stackable, cannot be debuffed). Hit with a single big hit per element, avoid multi-line spells. Each debuff spell he takes removes 30% resistance in all elements from him for 2 turns.
mech.wanted.viti-glourson.resistances-ad.notes.0: A debuff spell that deals damage also gives him resistance in its element.
mech.wanted.viti-glourson.resistances-ad.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.viti-glourson.resistances-ad.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Kill order: kill Viti first, or first finish off a monster that is already badly damaged.
mech.wanted.viti-glourson.resistances-ad.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: Each monster killed while Viti is alive gives him 3 AP (infinite, stackable); when he dies, the remaining monsters are healed to 100% and gain 2 MP (infinite).
mech.wanted.viti-glourson.resistances-ad.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Before attacking him, buff up as much as possible and use your hardest-hitting spell.
mech.wanted.viti-glourson.resistances-ad.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Each damage line gives him 30% resistance in the element used and 150 of the linked characteristic for 2 turns (stackable, not debuffable).
mech.wanted.viti-glourson.resistances-ad.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Don't use spells or weapons with multiple damage lines.
mech.wanted.viti-glourson.resistances-ad.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: From the second line on, he has already gained 30% resistance in that element.
mech.wanted.viti-glourson.resistances-ad.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Don't hit him again in an element already used within 2 turns.
mech.wanted.viti-glourson.resistances-ad.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Debuff him as soon as possible.
mech.wanted.viti-glourson.resistances-ad.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: Each debuff spell removes 30% resistance in all elements from him for 2 turns; if that spell deals damage, he still gains resistance in its element.
mech.wanted.viti-glourson.resistances-ad.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: Any attempt gives him 25 damage reflection for 3 turns.
mech.wanted.viti-glourson.resistances-ad.sequences.0.steps.7.action: With a Pandawa, avoid carrying monsters or characters.
mech.wanted.viti-glourson.resistances-ad.sequences.0.steps.7.rationale: Carrier: -25% resistance (2 turns, stackable); carried character: -3 MP; carried monster: +2 AP, 2 MP, 2 range; carrying Viti hits the carrier for 300 earth.

mech.wanted.viti-glourson.mort-et-kills.title: Kill order: kill him first
mech.wanted.viti-glourson.mort-et-kills.summary: Each monster killed while Viti is alive gives him 3 AP (infinite, stackable). When he dies, all remaining monsters are healed to 100% and gain 2 MP (infinite). The guide advises killing him first, or first finishing off a monster that is already badly damaged.

mech.wanted.viti-glourson.porter.title: Pandawa carry/throw is penalized
mech.wanted.viti-glourson.porter.summary: Carrying applies penalties: the carrier loses 25% resistance (2 turns, stackable), a carried character loses 3 MP, a carried monster gains 2 AP/2 MP/2 range, and carrying Viti hits the carrier. Trying to reduce his AP gives him damage reflection.

mech.wanted.viti-glourson.allies-de-circ.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.viti-glourson.allies-de-circ.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -1700 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him (he also gives 1000 vitality to all monsters at the start of the fight). Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.ka-youloud.etats-yeux.title: Three states based on his vitality: Triple œil, Double œil, Cyclope
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.etats-yeux.summary: No invulnerability. At the start of his turn, he takes a state based on his vitality: Triple œil (more than 70%), Double œil (41 to 70%), Cyclope (40% or less); he doesn't change state mid-turn. Triple œil: resistance penalties and large areas, gains 25% resistance. Double œil: heals up to twice per turn, can go back to Triple œil. Cyclope: can instantly kill a marked target in melee. In all states he teleports twice by 5 cells and all his spells are area spells.
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.etats-yeux.notes.0: In Double œil, reduce his healing or make him Insoignable so he doesn't go back to Triple œil (the guide mentions Leçon de Grunob).
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.etats-yeux.unknownAspects.0: The state that enables the one-shot in Cyclope is named "Déjection acide" in the overview and associated with the spell "Liquide gastrique" in the tips.
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.etats-yeux.unknownAspects.1: The spell "Mâche Ouille" is presented as the one-shot spell in Cyclope but also as the source of the 25% resistance gain in Triple œil.

mech.wanted.ka-youloud.retrait-pa.title: Recommended method: lock him at 2 AP
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.retrait-pa.summary: He has 12 AP, all his spells cost 3 AP and he only has 50 AP dodge: bringing him down to 2 AP every turn prevents him from casting any spell. The guide mentions Xelor, Feca, Rogue, the Bâton du Koulosse and AP-reduction companions (Hulkrap, Traçon); only his first turn has to be endured.
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.retrait-pa.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.retrait-pa.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Preparation: bring AP reduction (Xelor, Feca, Rogue, Bâton du Koulosse, Hulkrap or Traçon companions), about 2 characters with 100 to 150 AP reduction.
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.retrait-pa.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: This is the simplest and most effective method according to the guide: he only has 50 AP dodge.
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.retrait-pa.sequences.0.steps.2.action: During the placement phase, scatter the characters across the map.
