mech.wanted.ka-youloud.retrait-pa.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: All his spells hit in an area with heavy penalties, and he has a huge amount of initiative: he often plays first.
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.retrait-pa.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Take his first turn, then debuff the penalties (especially the -10 MP, which only lasts one turn).
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.retrait-pa.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: With this method he will only be able to play his first turn; all his effects are debuffable.
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.retrait-pa.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Every turn, bring him down to 2 AP.
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.retrait-pa.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: He has 12 AP and all his spells cost 3 AP: at 2 AP, he can't cast any spell.
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.retrait-pa.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Hit freely as long as he doesn't have enough AP.
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.retrait-pa.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: The guide calls the fight an autowin with this method.
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.retrait-pa.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Without AP reduction: push him far away (he can't be carried), remove his MP and apply Pesanteur to him as soon as possible (Cra recommended, large map).
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.retrait-pa.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: His nasty effects hit in an area around him (about 5 range); Pesanteur blocks "Pas sage", his two 5-cell teleports.
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.retrait-pa.sequences.0.steps.7.action: In the Double œil state, reduce his healing (Leçon de Grunob) or make him Insoignable while you keep hitting.
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.retrait-pa.sequences.0.steps.7.rationale: He heals himself for about 1200 HP up to twice per turn and can go back to Triple œil.
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.retrait-pa.sequences.0.steps.8.action: As soon as he is in Cyclope (40% health or less), kill him without delay and avoid his contact.
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.retrait-pa.sequences.0.steps.8.rationale: "Mâche Ouille" one-shots in melee a target that has the "Déjection acide" state, and he removes 5 MP in an area.

mech.wanted.ka-youloud.distance-pesanteu.title: Alternative: keep him at range and Pesanteur, team scattered
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.distance-pesanteu.summary: His nastiest effects hit in an area around him (about 5 range). Push him far away (he can't be carried), remove his MP and apply Pesanteur to him, which blocks "Pas sage" (his teleports). Scatter the team from the placement phase, since he often plays first; all his penalties are debuffable.

mech.wanted.ka-youloud.allies-de-circons.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.ka-youloud.allies-de-circons.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -1400 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.hin.os-distance.title: One-shot at 10 range or more at the start of his turn (from turn 2)
mech.wanted.hin.os-distance.summary: No invulnerability. From turn 2, at the start of each of his turns, Hin kills every character 10 range or more from him: stay within a radius of 9. Watch out for the "Tétropré" combo (pushes back 3 and removes 3 MP, then he moves away), which can prevent you from getting back in time.
mech.wanted.hin.os-distance.sequences.0.label: Stay in the safe zone
mech.wanted.hin.os-distance.sequences.0.steps.1.action: End every turn 9 range or less from Hin, keeping enough to come back after a push.

mech.wanted.hin.distanss.title: "Distanss": a single damage line per attack
mech.wanted.hin.distanss.summary: Under "Distanss" (2 turns, every 4 turns), each damage line he receives makes him push back 3 cells and gain 1 MP: prefer powerful single-line spells during this effect.

mech.wanted.hin.poison-pm.title: Permanent poison on MP used
mech.wanted.hin.poison-pm.summary: As long as Hin is alive, each MP used makes all characters lose earth HP: move as little as possible.

mech.wanted.hin.allies-de-circonstance.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.hin.allies-de-circonstance.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -1400 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.fuji-givrefoux.os-melee.title: One-shot in melee: stay more than 5 range away (+1 per MP gained), in line
mech.wanted.fuji-givrefoux.os-melee.summary: No invulnerability. Once per turn, she can kill a character in contact with her and replace them with a monster from the area. Her only damage spell hits diagonally. Stay in line with her and more than 5 range away (4 MP + melee), plus 1 range per bonus MP.
mech.wanted.fuji-givrefoux.os-melee.notes.0: The Maho Givrefoux can pull a character 3 cells and make them reachable.
mech.wanted.fuji-givrefoux.os-melee.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.fuji-givrefoux.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Bring characters who remove MP or push back.
mech.wanted.fuji-givrefoux.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: The guide recommends them to make the fight easier and keep her far away.
mech.wanted.fuji-givrefoux.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Stay in line with Fuji Givrefoux, never diagonally.
mech.wanted.fuji-givrefoux.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.2.position: In line with her, far away
mech.wanted.fuji-givrefoux.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Her only damage spell, "Foufoux" (800 water life steal), is cast only diagonally at 3 to 4 range.
mech.wanted.fuji-givrefoux.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Stay more than 5 range from her.
mech.wanted.fuji-givrefoux.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Progéniture" one-shots a character in melee (1 time per turn) and replaces them with a monster from the area; she has 4 base MP.
mech.wanted.fuji-givrefoux.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.4.action: After each monster death, add 1 range of distance per MP gained.
mech.wanted.fuji-givrefoux.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: "Deuil": each time a monster dies, she gains 1000 damage and 1 MP for 1 turn, and the other monsters gain 1 MP.
mech.wanted.fuji-givrefoux.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Beware of the Maho Givrefoux if present.
mech.wanted.fuji-givrefoux.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: It pulls a character 3 cells (from 2 to 4 range), which can put them within reach of Fuji's melee.

mech.wanted.fuji-givrefoux.mort-monstre.title: Each monster killed empowers her for 1 turn
mech.wanted.fuji-givrefoux.mort-monstre.summary: Each time a monster dies, she gains 1000 damage and 1 MP for 1 turn, and the other monsters gain 1 MP: rethink your placement after each kill.

mech.wanted.fuji-givrefoux.allies-de-cir.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.fuji-givrefoux.allies-de-cir.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -1400 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with her. Alone in the fight, she has no penalty.

mech.wanted.glandaf-l-aigri.zone-3.title: Stay more than 3 range from Glandaf and the monsters
mech.wanted.glandaf-l-aigri.zone-3.summary: No invulnerability. At the start of each of his turns, he gives 2 MP to his allies and removes 2 MP from enemies within a radius of 3; he also hits in a radius-3 circle around himself and his allies.
mech.wanted.glandaf-l-aigri.zone-3.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.glandaf-l-aigri.zone-3.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Plan to hit with earth, then neutral or air; avoid fire and water.
mech.wanted.glandaf-l-aigri.zone-3.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: Resistances: 0% earth, 10% neutral, 20% air, but 60% fire and 40% water.
mech.wanted.glandaf-l-aigri.zone-3.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Always stay more than 3 range from Glandaf and from all monsters.
mech.wanted.glandaf-l-aigri.zone-3.sequences.0.steps.2.position: More than 3 range from each monster
mech.wanted.glandaf-l-aigri.zone-3.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Pèlerinage" removes 2 MP for 2 turns from enemies within a radius of 3 at the start of his turn; "Anneau de Feu" hits for 400 fire in a radius-3 circle around him and each of his allies.
mech.wanted.glandaf-l-aigri.zone-3.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Grisaille" steals 2 AP for 1 turn from characters in contact with him and pushes them back one cell.
mech.wanted.glandaf-l-aigri.zone-3.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Watch out for a distance of exactly 4 range.
mech.wanted.glandaf-l-aigri.zone-3.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: "Gnirdmalg" (at exactly 4 range, without line of sight) hits for 550 earth, applies 20% erosion and increases damage taken by 20% for 1 turn.
mech.wanted.glandaf-l-aigri.zone-3.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Take into account the bonus MP of his nearby allies.
mech.wanted.glandaf-l-aigri.zone-3.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: At the start of his turn, he gives 2 MP for 2 turns to himself and his allies within a radius of 3.

mech.wanted.glandaf-l-aigri.resistances.title: Very resistant to fire and water
mech.wanted.glandaf-l-aigri.resistances.summary: 60% fire and 40% water; 0% earth, 10% neutral, 20% air.

mech.wanted.glandaf-l-aigri.allies-de-ci.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.glandaf-l-aigri.allies-de-ci.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -1300 vitality (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.retrait-po.title: Range reduction: +50% resistance
mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.retrait-po.summary: No invulnerability, but each range reduction gives her 50% resistance for 2 turns. You can use this to keep her away while you kill her allies, without hitting her during this phase.
mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.retrait-po.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.retrait-po.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Preparation: if possible, bring a character able to debuff.
mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.retrait-po.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: The guide describes it as a big plus against her buffs.
mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.retrait-po.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Keep the Vengeuse Masquée more than 11 range from the characters.
mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.retrait-po.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: 8 base MP + 1 range for her melee spell + 2 MP from buffs; "Attaque Vengeresse" hits for 800 water life steal and steals 26 to 50 chance for 4 turns (stackable).
mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.retrait-po.sequences.0.steps.3.action: If there are monsters to kill first: you can reduce her range to keep her away, but without hitting her during this phase.
mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.retrait-po.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: Each range reduction gives her 50% resistance for 2 turns.
mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.retrait-po.sequences.0.steps.4.action: When you switch to her, stop reducing her range.
mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.retrait-po.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: "Justice aveugle": +50% resistance for 2 turns per range reduction.
mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.retrait-po.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Debuff her as soon as possible.
mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.retrait-po.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: "Esprit de Vengeance" (4-turn cooldown) gives her and the monsters 50 damage, 2 MP, 10% critical and 4 range for 4 turns: she is buffed almost the whole fight.
mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.retrait-po.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Expect to take "Coup de Bulle" at range.
mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.retrait-po.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: It is cast from 2 to 15 range, hits for 800 water and removes 2 to 3 MP; the guide says it is hard to avoid.

mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.distance.title: Keep her more than 11 range away
mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.distance.summary: Her melee spell hits very hard and steals chance: keep her more than 11 range away (8 MP + melee + 2 MP from buffs).

mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.desenvoutem.title: Debuff her as soon as possible
mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.desenvoutem.summary: Every 4 turns, she gives herself and her nearby allies damage, 2 MP, critical and range for 4 turns: a character able to debuff is a big advantage.

mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.allies-de-c.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.vengeuse-masquee.allies-de-c.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -1300 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with her. Alone in the fight, she has no penalty.

mech.wanted.aermyne-braco-scalptaras.ret.title: Never reduce her AP or MP (from turn 2)
mech.wanted.aermyne-braco-scalptaras.ret.summary: No invulnerability. From her second turn, each AP reduction attempt gives her 4 AP and each MP reduction attempt 3 MP, infinite and stackable: reductions are useless and counterproductive.
mech.wanted.aermyne-braco-scalptaras.ret.prerequisites.0: From her second turn of play.
mech.wanted.aermyne-braco-scalptaras.ret.notes.0: She heals and buffs her allies (power, MP) and pushes back 3 cells in melee.
mech.wanted.aermyne-braco-scalptaras.ret.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.aermyne-braco-scalptaras.ret.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Never try to reduce her AP or MP from her 2nd turn on.
mech.wanted.aermyne-braco-scalptaras.ret.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Implacable": each AP reduction attempt gives her 4 AP, each MP reduction attempt 3 MP, infinite and stackable.
mech.wanted.aermyne-braco-scalptaras.ret.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Note that the effect is not active yet on her 1st turn.
mech.wanted.aermyne-braco-scalptaras.ret.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: The guide states that the effect's charge only applies from the next turn, then stays for the whole fight.
mech.wanted.aermyne-braco-scalptaras.ret.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Malaxage" hits for 350 earth in melee and pushes back 3 cells.
mech.wanted.aermyne-braco-scalptaras.ret.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Take into account her support for the monsters.
mech.wanted.aermyne-braco-scalptaras.ret.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: "Câlin" (up to 6 range, 3 times per turn) heals an ally for about 200 and gives them 25 power and 2 to 3 MP for 3 turns.
mech.wanted.aermyne-braco-scalptaras.ret.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: Hits for 200 neutral life steal up to 8 range (4-turn cooldown).

mech.wanted.aermyne-braco-scalptaras.all.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.aermyne-braco-scalptaras.all.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -400 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with her. Alone in the fight, she has no penalty.

mech.wanted.aigripoil.os-melee.title: One-shot in melee (3-turn cooldown): stay out of his reach
mech.wanted.aigripoil.os-melee.summary: No invulnerability, but one spell kills a character in melee (3-turn cooldown). He gains 1 MP at the end of each turn (infinite, stackable) and can pull 3 cells in line up to 7 range with line of sight (also removes 3 MP). Stay far away, block line of sight, and kill him fast.
mech.wanted.aigripoil.os-melee.notes.0: His 3-cell pull can bring you into his contact; obstacles and summons block his line of sight.
mech.wanted.aigripoil.os-melee.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.aigripoil.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Bring Fire and Water spells to focus him first.
mech.wanted.aigripoil.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: Aigripoil has low resistances in these elements (-5% Fire and 5% Water) compared to the others.
mech.wanted.aigripoil.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Stay out of reach of his melee for the whole fight.
mech.wanted.aigripoil.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.2.position: At a safe distance from Aigripoil
mech.wanted.aigripoil.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Empalladium: he one-shots the target in melee (3-turn cooldown). He also gains 1 MP at the end of each turn (Galopage, infinite and stackable).
mech.wanted.aigripoil.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Don't stay in line with him between 2 and 7 range; block his line of sight with obstacles or summons.
mech.wanted.aigripoil.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: Aigrippement (in line from 2 to 7 range, line of sight required) hits for ~180 earth, pulls 3 cells and removes 3 MP to bring you into his melee.
mech.wanted.aigripoil.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.4.action: If possible, remove his MP or push him back.
mech.wanted.aigripoil.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: The guide suggests these means to prevent him from pulling you and reaching your melee.
mech.wanted.aigripoil.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Summon and let the summon get one-shot by Empalladium.
mech.wanted.aigripoil.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: The spell has a 3-turn cooldown: if he one-shots on turn 2, he can't cast it again before his turn 5. You are safe during that time.
mech.wanted.aigripoil.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.6.action: During these 3 turns, focus all damage on Aigripoil.
mech.wanted.aigripoil.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: The longer the fight lasts, the more MP he gains and the more easily he reaches your melee.
mech.wanted.aigripoil.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.7.action: If he is still alive at the end of the cooldown, repeat from step 5.
mech.wanted.aigripoil.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.7.rationale: "Repeat the operation if you haven't been able to eliminate Aigripoil by then."

mech.wanted.aigripoil.sacrifice-invocati.title: Sacrifice a summon to trigger the one-shot's cooldown
mech.wanted.aigripoil.sacrifice-invocati.summary: Letting a summon be killed by the one-shot gives 3 turns of safety (e.g. one-shot on turn 2, not again before turn 5). Repeat if needed.

mech.wanted.aigripoil.resistances.title: Weak to fire and water
mech.wanted.aigripoil.resistances.summary: Low resistances in fire (-5%) and water (5%): recommended elements to kill him fast.

mech.wanted.aigripoil.allies-de-circonst.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.aigripoil.allies-de-circonst.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -1100 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.ali-grothor.invulnerabilite.title: Invulnerable 2 turns out of 3, removed via "Grillade"
mech.wanted.ali-grothor.invulnerabilite.summary: On turn 2 and then every 3 turns, he becomes invulnerable (cannot be debuffed) for 2 turns: by default he is only vulnerable on turns 1, 4, 7, 10… At the same time he applies "Grillade" to all characters for 2 turns: if Ali is within a radius of 2 around a character under "Grillade" who starts their turn, he loses his invulnerability.
mech.wanted.ali-grothor.invulnerabilite.expectedStateChange: Ali Grothor loses his temporary invulnerability.
mech.wanted.ali-grothor.invulnerabilite.turnConditions: Invulnerable on turns 2-3, 5-6, 8-9…; vulnerable by default on turns 1, 4, 7, 10…
mech.wanted.ali-grothor.invulnerabilite.prerequisites.0: The character starting their turn is under "Grillade".
mech.wanted.ali-grothor.invulnerabilite.prerequisites.1: Ali Grothor is 2 range or less from that character.
mech.wanted.ali-grothor.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.label: Remove the invulnerability
mech.wanted.ali-grothor.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.1.action: As soon as he becomes invulnerable, place a character who hasn't played yet 2 range or less from Ali (by moving Ali or the character).
mech.wanted.ali-grothor.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Wait for the start of that character's turn.
mech.wanted.ali-grothor.invulnerabilite.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Grillade" triggers at the start of the turn and removes the invulnerability.

mech.wanted.ali-grothor.grillade-malus.title: "Grillade": spread out and heal last
mech.wanted.ali-grothor.grillade-malus.summary: Each turn start under "Grillade" hits the character and their neighbors (radius 2) for about 500 fire and adds the Foudroyé state (3 turns, stackable), which strengthens his spells. Keep more than 2 range between allies; a heal received after "Grillade" triggers removes Foudroyé, hence a healer who plays last (or first if they have initiative over Ali).

mech.wanted.ali-grothor.retrait-po.title: Don't reduce his range
mech.wanted.ali-grothor.retrait-po.summary: Each range reduction gives him 1 MP (infinite, stackable). His melee spell hits hard and he can teleport up to 5 range every turn.

mech.wanted.ali-grothor.allies-de-circon.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.ali-grothor.allies-de-circon.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -900 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.ronces.title: Bramble blocks around each character (turns 1, 7, 13…)
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.ronces.summary: No invulnerability. On turn 1 and then every 6 turns, she surrounds each character with a square of static brambles (size 2) and applies Pesanteur for 2 turns (debuffable). She gains 1000 shield points for 1 turn per bramble in contact with her at the start of her turn. The guide advises clearing a path or using the Cra's "Flèche Fulminante" (taking into account the 50 reflection per bramble).

mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.title: "Empathique" state: one character takes 50% of the damage dealt to Amy
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.summary: Each turn, "Poison végétal" makes one character Empathique (1 turn, cannot be debuffed): they take 50% of the damage dealt to Amy. Guide solutions: protect that character (Barricade or Prohibition in contact with Amy, Bastion at range, Ataraxie, Égide, Sac Animé), reduce the damage, or sacrifice them and finish Amy within the turn.
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Choose the team: with many players, spread the characters out and sacrifice the one taking the reflection; with few, bring a tank Pandawa who carries the damage dealer and a protection class.
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: With many players, Stranguronces spreads faster; with few, the 50% reflection is hard to manage.
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.sequences.0.steps.2.action: During placement, space the characters out (or place them near Amy / near map obstacles).
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.sequences.0.steps.2.position: Never in a size-2 square around an ally
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Stranguronces spreads to nearby allies; near map obstacles, fewer brambles are summoned.
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.sequences.0.steps.3.action: If a character has more initiative than Amy, hit her as hard as possible before she plays.
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: At the start there are no brambles yet and no Empathique state on an ally.
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Get out of the brambles: use Flèche Fulminante (Cra) or break a path; don't leave brambles in contact with Amy.
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: Forêt épineuse on turns 1, 7, 13…; each bramble in contact gives Amy 1000 shield points. Watch out for the 50 reflection per bramble (~1200 on the Cra for one block).
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Before hitting, protect the "Empathique" character (Barricade / Prohibition if they are in contact with Amy, Bastion if at range, or Ataraxie, Égide, Sac Animé).
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: That character takes 50% of the damage dealt to Amy; the state is not debuffable.
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Failing that, sacrifice the Empathique character and kill Amy in the same turn.
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: Once they are dead, nobody takes the reflection until Amy's next turn.
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.sequences.0.steps.7.action: Never reduce her AP or MP.
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.sequences.0.steps.7.rationale: Each attempt gives her 5% of her HP as a shield (about 1600 shield points, infinite).
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.sequences.0.steps.8.action: Use life steal spells and kill her quickly.
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.empathiq.sequences.0.steps.8.rationale: Her weaknesses range from -115% to -60%; the longer the fight lasts, the more Stranguronces stacks air poisons and Power penalties.

mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.strangur.title: "Stranguronces" spreads: don't stay grouped
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.strangur.summary: This spell (earth, air poison and a 150 power penalty over 3 turns, stackable) spreads at the start of each of Amy's turns from each character hit, over a growing area: contact (Parasite granuleux), 3x3 square (éclos), 5x5 square (fleuri). Never stay in a size-2 square around an ally.

mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.retraits.title: Don't reduce her AP or MP
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.retraits.summary: Each AP or MP reduction attempt gives her a shield of 5% of her HP (infinite), about 1600 shield points.
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.retraits.notes.0: A dead character is replaced by an Abrakleur Sombre that plays against the team.

mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.allies-d.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.amy-l-empoisonneuse.allies-d.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -2000 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with her. Alone in the fight, she has no penalty.

mech.wanted.anatak-diskedor.charges.title: 4-turn charge cycle and "Bretteur Céleste" state (turns 3, 7, 11…)
mech.wanted.anatak-diskedor.charges.summary: No invulnerability. Charge 1: +500 power (3 turns); charge 2: +1000 power and +10% critical (2 turns); charge 3: "Bretteur Céleste" state (1 turn); charge 4: removes Foudroyé from characters; then the cycle restarts (turns 5, 9, 13…). In Bretteur Céleste, "Coup de Foudre" kills a Foudroyé character in melee, "Frappe purificatrice" removes 100 MP for 1 turn, "Lame-tempête" steals life.
mech.wanted.anatak-diskedor.charges.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.anatak-diskedor.charges.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: Lame-tempête hits for ~450 air in a radius-3 circle around him and applies Insoignable (1 time per turn).
mech.wanted.anatak-diskedor.charges.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Follow his charge cycle: turn 1 +500 Power, turn 2 +1000 Power and 10% critical, turn 3 "Bretteur Céleste" state, turn 4 removal of the Foudroyé state.
mech.wanted.anatak-diskedor.charges.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Puissance de la Foudre" effect, reset every 4 turns (turns 5, 9, 13…).
mech.wanted.anatak-diskedor.charges.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Spot the characters hit by Coup de Foudre (Foudroyé state).
mech.wanted.anatak-diskedor.charges.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: Coup de Foudre (melee, 1 time per turn) hits for ~500 air and applies Foudroyé (infinite); he can mark at most 2 before Bretteur Céleste.
mech.wanted.anatak-diskedor.charges.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Before his turns 3, 7, 11…, move Foudroyé characters as far from Anatak as possible.
mech.wanted.anatak-diskedor.charges.sequences.0.steps.4.position: Far from Anatak for Foudroyé characters
mech.wanted.anatak-diskedor.charges.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: In Bretteur Céleste, Coup de Foudre one-shots a Foudroyé character in melee.
mech.wanted.anatak-diskedor.charges.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Beware of the Frappe purificatrice + Coup de Foudre combo.
mech.wanted.anatak-diskedor.charges.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: Frappe purificatrice (in line up to 8 range) teleports him; this lets him reach the Foudroyé character. In Bretteur Céleste it also removes 100 MP for 1 turn.
mech.wanted.anatak-diskedor.charges.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Repeat this placement every 4-turn cycle until he dies.
mech.wanted.anatak-diskedor.charges.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: Turn 4 removes the Foudroyé state, then the cycle restarts on turn 5.

mech.wanted.anatak-diskedor.eviter-os.title: Move Foudroyé characters away on Bretteur Céleste turns
mech.wanted.anatak-diskedor.eviter-os.summary: He only applies Foudroyé once per turn before becoming Bretteur Céleste (at most 2 characters). On turns 3, 7, 11…, move these characters away; watch out for the teleport combo "Frappe purificatrice" then "Coup de Foudre". Don't group the team: his Insoignable spell (once per turn) hits a radius of 3 around him.

mech.wanted.anatak-diskedor.allies-de-ci.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.anatak-diskedor.allies-de-ci.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -1300 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.bouflouth.os-melee.title: One-shot in melee from turn 6: stay more than 7 range away
mech.wanted.bouflouth.os-melee.summary: No invulnerability. He only hits in melee; from turn 6 and then every 5 turns, he can instantly kill a character in contact with him and replace them with a monster. Stay more than 7 range away (6 MP + melee) and avoid pushing him: each push gives him 1 MP.
mech.wanted.bouflouth.os-melee.prerequisites.0: One-shot possible from turn 6, then every 5 turns.
mech.wanted.bouflouth.os-melee.notes.0: The legendary Boufmouth can give him 3 MP (6 on a critical) for 2 turns or push a character 4 cells towards him.
mech.wanted.bouflouth.os-melee.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.bouflouth.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Position yourself and stay more than 7 range from Bouflouth.
mech.wanted.bouflouth.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.1.position: More than 7 range from the boss
mech.wanted.bouflouth.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: He only attacks in melee; 6 base MP + melee range: at more than 7 range, you never take his damage.
mech.wanted.bouflouth.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Don't push him (except with spells that push far enough).
mech.wanted.bouflouth.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Poussmouth" effect: +1 MP (stackable) for 1 turn per push.
mech.wanted.bouflouth.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.3.action: From turn 6, never let him reach contact with a character.
mech.wanted.bouflouth.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: Gloutmouth one-shots a character in melee and replaces them with a Bouftonmouth, from turn 6 and then every 5 turns.
mech.wanted.bouflouth.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Keep an eye on the legendary Boufmouth if it accompanies him.
mech.wanted.bouflouth.os-melee.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: It can give Bouflouth 3 MP (6 on a critical) for 2 turns or push a character 4 cells towards him.

mech.wanted.bouflouth.allies-de-circonst.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.bouflouth.allies-de-circonst.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -800 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.bouss-baybe.attirance.title: Don't end your turn in her lines or diagonals
mech.wanted.bouss-baybe.attirance.summary: No invulnerability. At the start of each of her turns, she pulls every character in line or diagonal with her 2 cells; her only damage spell (water) has a range of 4. She buffs her monsters with 2 AP, 4 MP and 100 power for the whole fight.
mech.wanted.bouss-baybe.attirance.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.bouss-baybe.attirance.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: Porkasserie (2-turn cooldown) kills a summon and replaces it with a Berger or Cavalier Porkass buffed with 2 AP, 4 MP and 100 Power that plays against you.
mech.wanted.bouss-baybe.attirance.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Keep the characters spaced apart from each other.
mech.wanted.bouss-baybe.attirance.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Éconduire (size-1 cross area, once per turn) applies -200 Power and Affaibli for 2 turns: only one character should be hit.
mech.wanted.bouss-baybe.attirance.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Never end your turn in line or diagonal with Bouss Baybe.
mech.wanted.bouss-baybe.attirance.sequences.0.steps.3.position: Out of her lines and diagonals, at range
mech.wanted.bouss-baybe.attirance.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: At the start of each turn, she pulls every character in her lines and diagonals 2 cells.
mech.wanted.bouss-baybe.attirance.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Stay out of range of her only damage spell.
mech.wanted.bouss-baybe.attirance.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: Salon hits for ~130 water up to 4 range.

mech.wanted.bouss-baybe.invocations.title: Avoid summoning and stay spaced out
mech.wanted.bouss-baybe.invocations.summary: Every 2 turns, she can kill a summon and replace it with a buffed Porkass that plays against you. Her penalty (-200 power and Affaibli, 2 turns) hits a size-1 cross, once per turn: space the characters out.

mech.wanted.bouss-baybe.allies-de-circon.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.bouss-baybe.allies-de-circon.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -200 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with her. Alone in the fight, she has no penalty.

mech.wanted.brumen-tinctorias.simple.title: Target with no particular mechanic
mech.wanted.brumen-tinctorias.simple.summary: No invulnerability or special mechanic described: he buffs AP, heals and hits.
mech.wanted.brumen-tinctorias.simple.unknownAspects.0: The page gives no damage elements, resistances or tactical tips.

mech.wanted.brumen-tinctorias.allies-de-.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.brumen-tinctorias.allies-de-.summary: Effect shared by wanted targets: -250 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.carlita-de-l-aguerfelde.vita.title: +2000 vitality to her monsters while she lives
mech.wanted.carlita-de-l-aguerfelde.vita.summary: No invulnerability. At the start of the fight, she gives 2000 vitality (infinite) to her monsters; this bonus disappears when she dies.
mech.wanted.carlita-de-l-aguerfelde.vita.expectedStateChange: When she dies, the monsters lose the 2000 vitality bonus.

mech.wanted.carlita-de-l-aguerfelde.pieg.title: Pièges à Mulou: limit your movement
mech.wanted.carlita-de-l-aguerfelde.pieg.summary: She places up to 2 1-cell traps per turn: stepping into one removes 15 MP and gives Pesanteur, Inébranlable and "Piégé comme un Mulou" for 2 turns. On a trapped target, she can pull herself into contact and hit very hard in air (about 3000). The guide advises avoiding moving.
mech.wanted.carlita-de-l-aguerfelde.pieg.sequences.0.label: Steps
mech.wanted.carlita-de-l-aguerfelde.pieg.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Kill Carlita to remove her monsters' vitality bonus.
mech.wanted.carlita-de-l-aguerfelde.pieg.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Pas touche à mes manteaux !" gives +2000 Vitality to all monsters; the bonus disappears when she dies.
mech.wanted.carlita-de-l-aguerfelde.pieg.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: She places up to 2 1-cell traps per turn (up to 8 range without line of sight).
mech.wanted.carlita-de-l-aguerfelde.pieg.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Don't fall into a Piège à Mulou.
mech.wanted.carlita-de-l-aguerfelde.pieg.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: The trap removes 15 MP for 2 turns and applies Piégé comme un Mulou, Pesanteur and Inébranlable for 2 turns (not debuffable).
mech.wanted.carlita-de-l-aguerfelde.pieg.sequences.0.steps.4.action: If a character is trapped, beware of Dépeçage.
mech.wanted.carlita-de-l-aguerfelde.pieg.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: On a Trapped target (in line up to 6 range), she pulls herself into contact and hits for ~3000 air.

mech.wanted.carlita-de-l-aguerfelde.alli.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.carlita-de-l-aguerfelde.alli.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -600 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with her. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.darma.fumee-noire.title: "Fumée Noire": different positioning depending on turn parity
mech.wanted.darma.fumee-noire.summary: No invulnerability. She alternates turns with and without green glyphs (radius 3 around each monster: air hit and range penalty if you start your turn inside); on the other parity, she removes the glyphs and hits neutral while removing AP from characters more than 3 range from a monster. The guide advises being more than 3 range from the monsters before an odd turn, and exactly 3 range from a monster before an even turn.
mech.wanted.darma.fumee-noire.unknownAspects.0: Contradiction on the page: the text places the glyphs on odd turns, the image caption on even turns.
mech.wanted.darma.fumee-noire.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.darma.fumee-noire.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Bring direct damage, no glyphs or traps, and avoid the neutral element (watch out for weapons).
mech.wanted.darma.fumee-noire.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: Fumée Noire reduces glyph and trap damage (actual reduction of 80); Darma has 50% neutral resistance.
mech.wanted.darma.fumee-noire.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Before an odd Darma turn: place all characters more than 3 range from every monster.
mech.wanted.darma.fumee-noire.sequences.0.steps.2.position: More than 3 range from every monster
mech.wanted.darma.fumee-noire.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: She places radius-3 green glyphs around each monster: starting your turn inside hits ~150 air and removes 6 range for 1 turn.
mech.wanted.darma.fumee-noire.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Before an even Darma turn: stand exactly 3 range from a monster.
mech.wanted.darma.fumee-noire.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: She hits ~350 neutral and removes 4 AP from those not within radius 3 of a monster; at exactly 3 range, you also avoid Vue en Noir (radius 2).
mech.wanted.darma.fumee-noire.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Never stay 2 range or less from a monster when Darma plays.
mech.wanted.darma.fumee-noire.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: Vue en Noir hits ~300 earth in a radius-2 circle around her and each of her allies (several hits if several monsters are close).
mech.wanted.darma.fumee-noire.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Repeat the positioning alternation every turn until she dies.
mech.wanted.darma.fumee-noire.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: The Fumée Noire effect alternates glyphs and glyph removal for the whole fight.

mech.wanted.darma.zone-allies.title: Stay more than 2 range from every monster
mech.wanted.darma.zone-allies.summary: She hits in a radius-2 area around each of her allies, possibly several hits.

mech.wanted.darma.glyphes-pieges.title: Glyphs and traps heavily reduced; 50% neutral
mech.wanted.darma.glyphes-pieges.summary: She reduces glyph and trap damage by 10 (actual reduction of 80): favour direct damage. She has 50% neutral resistance (watch out for weapons).
mech.wanted.darma.glyphes-pieges.notes.0: She can make her whole team invisible for 1 turn and reduce damage taken by 20% every 4 turns.

mech.wanted.darma.allies-de-circonstance.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.darma.allies-de-circonstance.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -1000 vitality (infinite) per monster present with her. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.degolas.vol-po.title: Stay close to him (range removal/steal)
mech.wanted.degolas.vol-po.summary: No invulnerability. All his spells remove or steal range: stay close so you can still hit him.
mech.wanted.degolas.vol-po.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.degolas.vol-po.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Move close to Degolas and stay close.
mech.wanted.degolas.vol-po.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: All his spells remove or steal range (Flèche Aveuglante steals 4 range, stackable): up close, you can hit him even without range.
mech.wanted.degolas.vol-po.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Do not line up your characters with each other.
mech.wanted.degolas.vol-po.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Flèche Repoussante hits ~300 earth in a size-3 line and pushes the first target back 3 cells into the ally behind (pushback damage).
mech.wanted.degolas.vol-po.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Tir Précis" effect: +50% critical for 1 turn on those turns.
mech.wanted.degolas.vol-po.sequences.0.steps.4.action: In melee, expect range removal and pushback.
mech.wanted.degolas.vol-po.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: Masque Aveuglant (melee) hits ~150 water, removes 3 range for 2 turns and pushes back 1 cell.

mech.wanted.degolas.ligne.title: Do not line up your characters
mech.wanted.degolas.ligne.summary: His line area spell pushes the first character back 3 cells: an ally behind causes pushback damage.

mech.wanted.degolas.allies-de-circonstan.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.degolas.allies-de-circonstan.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -500 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.dragodingo.humeurs.title: Random moods and 15 MP: block her or lock her
mech.wanted.dragodingo.humeurs.summary: No invulnerability. Each turn, a random mood gives her a bonus (dodge, AP/MP dodge or power) and changes her spells (random element). With 15 base MP, she can run far away: block her in a corner or lock her.
mech.wanted.dragodingo.humeurs.unknownAspects.0: The page does not detail which effect matches which mood.
mech.wanted.dragodingo.humeurs.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.dragodingo.humeurs.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Block Dragodingo in a corner or lock her.
mech.wanted.dragodingo.humeurs.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: She has 15 base MP and can run very far, especially if you have little range.
mech.wanted.dragodingo.humeurs.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Humeur Instable: +20 Dodge, +20 AP/MP Dodge or +100 Power for 1 turn, and her spells change effect depending on the mood.
mech.wanted.dragodingo.humeurs.sequences.0.steps.3.action: In melee, expect her melee effects.
mech.wanted.dragodingo.humeurs.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: Dingoboule (melee): removal of 3 MP + Pesanteur, pushback of 3 cells, or ~300 neutral life steal + Affaibli depending on the mood.
mech.wanted.dragodingo.humeurs.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Watch out for her line up to 4 range.
mech.wanted.dragodingo.humeurs.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: Dingosouffle (size-4 line area, cast in line up to 4 range): Insoignable, 30% erosion or +20% damage taken for 2 turns.

mech.wanted.dragodingo.allies-de-circons.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.dragodingo.allies-de-circons.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -400 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with her. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.fantomayte.deplacements.title: -100 power per forced movement: avoid being moved
mech.wanted.fantomayte.deplacements.summary: No invulnerability. Any character pushed, pulled, teleported or swapped loses 100 power for 2 turns (stackable). Do not move your allies; "Stabilisation" helps; standing in a corner blocked by two walls prevents movement (pushback damage only), except for swaps (Vigie pirate) or pulls (Fancrôme).
mech.wanted.fantomayte.deplacements.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.fantomayte.deplacements.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Place each character in a corner of the map, with two walls blocking the adjacent cells.
mech.wanted.fantomayte.deplacements.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: Pushed against a wall, you take pushback damage but are not moved and do not lose Power.
mech.wanted.fantomayte.deplacements.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Do not push, pull or swap an ally, or teleport; use spells like Stabilisation.
mech.wanted.fantomayte.deplacements.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Mille pompons" effect: each forced movement removes 100 Power for 2 turns (stackable).
mech.wanted.fantomayte.deplacements.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Watch the Vigie pirate and the Fancrôme if they accompany her.
mech.wanted.fantomayte.deplacements.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: The Vigie pirate swaps places (2 to 4 range) and the Fancrôme pulls: the corner does not protect against them.
mech.wanted.fantomayte.deplacements.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: She teleports up to 15 range without line of sight, hits ~350 air around her arrival cell and pushes back 4 cells (2 times per turn).
mech.wanted.fantomayte.deplacements.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Take her damage reflection (Littérature) into account.
mech.wanted.fantomayte.deplacements.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: Reflects 400 damage for 3 turns (4 on crit), debuffable.

mech.wanted.fantomayte.renvoi.title: Debuffable damage reflection (3 turns)
mech.wanted.fantomayte.renvoi.summary: One of her spells gives her damage reflection for 3 turns, which can be debuffed.

mech.wanted.fantomayte.allies-de-circons.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.fantomayte.allies-de-circons.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -1100 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with her. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.fojumo.doubles.title: Doubles: find and kill the real Fojumo
mech.wanted.fojumo.doubles.summary: No invulnerability. From the start he summons as many doubles as there are characters; they hit and apply Marque Ninja (the real Fojumo hits harder on these targets). The doubles disappear when he dies: no need to kill them.
mech.wanted.fojumo.doubles.expectedStateChange: Fojumo's death makes all the doubles disappear.
mech.wanted.fojumo.doubles.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.fojumo.doubles.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Do not try to kill all the doubles.
mech.wanted.fojumo.doubles.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: He summons as many doubles (4400 HP) as there are characters in the fight; they are only his summons.
mech.wanted.fojumo.doubles.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Spot the real Fojumo, even when invisible.
mech.wanted.fojumo.doubles.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Dissimulation nocive (from turn 1, 4-turn cooldown) places a radius-7 black glyph that makes his allies invisible and Intaclable for 2 turns; only the real Fojumo does not become Intaclable.
mech.wanted.fojumo.doubles.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Avoid being marked by the doubles in melee.
mech.wanted.fojumo.doubles.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: Marquage applies Marque Ninja: the real Fojumo's Assassinat silencieux then deals a second hit of ~350 neutral.
mech.wanted.fojumo.doubles.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Focus damage on the real Fojumo until he dies.
mech.wanted.fojumo.doubles.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: His summons disappear with him as soon as he dies.

mech.wanted.fojumo.glyphe-noir.title: Black glyph: invisibility and Intaclable
mech.wanted.fojumo.glyphe-noir.summary: On turn 1 and then every 4 turns, he places a radius-7 black glyph that makes his team invisible and Intaclable for 2 turns while inside it.

mech.wanted.fojumo.allies-de-circonstanc.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.fojumo.allies-de-circonstanc.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -1000 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.fouduglen-l-ecureuil.invisib.title: Surround him to find him when he is invisible
mech.wanted.fouduglen-l-ecureuil.invisib.summary: No invulnerability. He can become invisible for 3 turns (7-turn cooldown); having no forced-movement spell, he cannot move if surrounded. Ideally a character with initiative (Pandawa) blocks him in a corner from turn 1.
mech.wanted.fouduglen-l-ecureuil.invisib.notes.0: He can remove invulnerable states from your characters.
mech.wanted.fouduglen-l-ecureuil.invisib.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.fouduglen-l-ecureuil.invisib.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Bring a character who has initiative over Fouduglen, ideally a Pandawa.
mech.wanted.fouduglen-l-ecureuil.invisib.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: You must block him from the first turn, before he plays.
mech.wanted.fouduglen-l-ecureuil.invisib.sequences.0.steps.2.action: On turn 1, put Fouduglen in a corner (Pandawa) and block his remaining cells with the Pandawa and a summon (e.g. Pandawasta).
mech.wanted.fouduglen-l-ecureuil.invisib.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: He has no transposition, pushback or teleport spell: surrounded, he can no longer move.
mech.wanted.fouduglen-l-ecureuil.invisib.sequences.0.steps.3.action: When he becomes invisible, keep him surrounded: you know where he is.
mech.wanted.fouduglen-l-ecureuil.invisib.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: Discrétion makes him invisible for 3 turns (7-turn cooldown) but, blocked, he stays in place.
mech.wanted.fouduglen-l-ecureuil.invisib.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Do not rely on Invulnerable states against him.
mech.wanted.fouduglen-l-ecureuil.invisib.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: Casse-noisettes (up to 6 range) hits ~350 neutral + 50 earth and removes any Invulnerable state.

mech.wanted.fouduglen-l-ecureuil.allies-.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.fouduglen-l-ecureuil.allies-.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -40 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.frakacia-leukocytine.malus-p.title: -2 AP to the whole team until she dies; ranged reduction
mech.wanted.frakacia-leukocytine.malus-p.summary: No invulnerability. From the start, she removes 2 AP from all characters (removed on her death) and reduces ranged damage by 2 (actual reduction of 5 per hit): melee attacks are slightly more effective.
mech.wanted.frakacia-leukocytine.malus-p.expectedStateChange: On her death, the 2 AP penalty disappears.

mech.wanted.frakacia-leukocytine.pacifis.title: Move away before her Pacifiste spell (turns 2, 5, 8…)
mech.wanted.frakacia-leukocytine.pacifis.summary: On turns 2, 5, 8, 11…, her spell makes characters within radius 6 Pacifiste and reduces the duration of effects by 4 on characters at 7 range or more. Move away on the previous turns (1, 4, 7…). Stay more than 5 range away to avoid her melee resistance penalty.
mech.wanted.frakacia-leukocytine.pacifis.unknownAspects.0: The spell name is spelled "Hyperleukocytine" and "Hyperleukocytrine" on the page.
mech.wanted.frakacia-leukocytine.pacifis.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.frakacia-leukocytine.pacifis.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Plan to play with 2 fewer AP until she dies.
mech.wanted.frakacia-leukocytine.pacifis.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Manchot" effect: -2 AP to all your characters while she is alive.
mech.wanted.frakacia-leukocytine.pacifis.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Normally stay more than 5 range from her.
mech.wanted.frakacia-leukocytine.pacifis.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Crochet fracassant (melee) applies -20% Neutral and Earth resistance for 2 turns; she has 4 base MP.
mech.wanted.frakacia-leukocytine.pacifis.sequences.0.steps.3.action: On turns 1, 4, 7, 10…, move more than 6 range away from Frakacia.
mech.wanted.frakacia-leukocytine.pacifis.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: On turns 2, 5, 8, 11…, Hyperleukocytine makes all characters within radius 6 Pacifiste (unable to deal damage).
mech.wanted.frakacia-leukocytine.pacifis.sequences.0.steps.4.action: For maximum damage, favour melee attacks outside those turns.
mech.wanted.frakacia-leukocytine.pacifis.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: She reduces ranged damage taken (actual reduction of 5 per hit).
mech.wanted.frakacia-leukocytine.pacifis.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Go back to step 3 every 3 turns until she dies.

mech.wanted.frakacia-leukocytine.allies-.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.frakacia-leukocytine.allies-.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -80 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with her. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.guman.exi-dernier.title: Kill Exi Guman last (restores his allies)
mech.wanted.guman.exi-dernier.summary: No invulnerability. On his death, Exi Guman restores all his allies to full HP and gives them 100 power (infinite): do not kill him while other monsters are damaged, keep him for the end.
mech.wanted.guman.exi-dernier.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.guman.exi-dernier.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Kill the monsters accompanying the Gumans first.
mech.wanted.guman.exi-dernier.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: The guide advises keeping Ambi for the end (last or second-to-last) and Exi for the very last.
mech.wanted.guman.exi-dernier.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Hit Ambi Guman with powerful spells, with as few damage lines as possible.
mech.wanted.guman.exi-dernier.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: On each damage line, he boosts himself and his allies by 50 Power and 1 range for 4 turns (Fils du Soleil).
mech.wanted.guman.exi-dernier.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Stay more than 3 range from any Citwouillette, or kill it as soon as it is summoned (130 HP).
mech.wanted.guman.exi-dernier.sequences.0.steps.3.position: More than 3 range from the Citwouillette
mech.wanted.guman.exi-dernier.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: Légumisation steals 2 AP and 50 of each characteristic for 2 turns in a radius-2 circle (range 2 + 1 MP).
mech.wanted.guman.exi-dernier.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Do not kill Exi Guman while other monsters are damaged: kill him last.
mech.wanted.guman.exi-dernier.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: On his death, Dans les choux heals all his allies to their max HP and gives them +100 Power (infinite).

mech.wanted.guman.ambi-lignes.title: Ambi Guman: as few damage lines as possible
mech.wanted.guman.ambi-lignes.summary: Each time he is hit, Ambi Guman gives himself and his allies 50 power and 1 range for 4 turns: use powerful single-line spells, or keep him for the end.

mech.wanted.guman.citwouillette.title: Citwouillette: stay more than 3 range away
mech.wanted.guman.citwouillette.summary: Ambi Guman summons a Citwouillette (1 MP, 130 HP) that steals AP and characteristics in radius 2: stay more than 3 range away or kill it as soon as it is summoned.

mech.wanted.guman.allies-de-circonstance.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.guman.allies-de-circonstance.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -90 vitality per monster present, and -40 power (Ambi Guman) or -35 power (Exi Guman), infinite. Alone in the fight, he has no penalty.

mech.wanted.jerart-dupaindur.bouteille.title: Bouteille de Pandabsynthe: +80% resistance, kill it on the turn it is summoned
mech.wanted.jerart-dupaindur.bouteille.summary: No invulnerability. He summons a Bouteille de Pandabsynthe (every 2 turns, normally on odd turns). When it plays, if he is 10 range or less away, he gains 80% resistance (95% in total), Pesanteur, Indéplaçable, Lourd, -4 MP and -100 power for 1 turn. The effects last until his next turn even if the bottle dies: kill it on the very turn it is summoned so you can hit him on even turns.
mech.wanted.jerart-dupaindur.bouteille.turnConditions: Bottle normally summoned on odd turns; damage window on even turns.
mech.wanted.jerart-dupaindur.bouteille.sequences.0.label: Recommended cycle
mech.wanted.jerart-dupaindur.bouteille.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Kill the bottle during the turn it is summoned.
mech.wanted.jerart-dupaindur.bouteille.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Hit Jérart on the following even turn, once he has played again.
mech.wanted.jerart-dupaindur.bouteille.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: The effects remain until his next turn.

mech.wanted.jerart-dupaindur.bloquer-inv.title: Prevent the summon by blocking his 8 cells
mech.wanted.jerart-dupaindur.bloquer-inv.summary: Blocking the 8 cells within his summon range (4 adjacent, 4 diagonal at 1 range) prevents him from summoning: placing him against an edge leaves 5 cells to occupy. Stay in place even on even turns, because the offset cooldown can let him summon on an even turn.
mech.wanted.jerart-dupaindur.bloquer-inv.notes.0: He and his bottles pull everyone 4 cells in a star pattern at the start of their turns; he can heal an ally for 100% of its HP.

mech.wanted.jerart-dupaindur.allies-de-c.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.jerart-dupaindur.allies-de-c.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -900 vitality (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.katigrou.pv-manquants.title: Hits based on his missing HP: stay more than 6 range away
mech.wanted.katigrou.pv-manquants.summary: No invulnerability. His melee spell hits for 20% of his missing HP; he steals 1 AP from adjacent enemies at the start of his turn and can teleport up to 12 range (preventable with Pesanteur). Once he is damaged, stay more than 6 range away and finish him quickly; erosion reduces his missing HP.
mech.wanted.katigrou.pv-manquants.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.katigrou.pv-manquants.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Do not stay adjacent to Katigrou.
mech.wanted.katigrou.pv-manquants.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: Jovialité: at the start of each turn, he steals 1 AP from enemies adjacent to him.
mech.wanted.katigrou.pv-manquants.sequences.0.steps.2.action: As soon as he is damaged, stay more than 6 range from him.
mech.wanted.katigrou.pv-manquants.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Grougrou (melee) hits ~200 neutral + 20% of his missing HP as earth; 5 base MP + 1 range.
mech.wanted.katigrou.pv-manquants.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Put the Pesanteur state on him.
mech.wanted.katigrou.pv-manquants.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: Bond Improbable teleports him up to 12 range next to a target, combinable with Grougrou; Pesanteur prevents it.
mech.wanted.katigrou.pv-manquants.sequences.0.steps.4.action: If you cannot stay at range, erode him.
mech.wanted.katigrou.pv-manquants.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: Erosion reduces his maximum HP, and therefore his missing HP: he hits less hard.
mech.wanted.katigrou.pv-manquants.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Focus him and finish him quickly once he is damaged.
mech.wanted.katigrou.pv-manquants.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: The more HP he loses, the more his melee spell hurts. Watch out for monsters that can push you towards him or swap places.

mech.wanted.katigrou.allies-de-circonsta.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.katigrou.allies-de-circonsta.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -1000 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.maitre-boulet.retrait-pm.title: -2 MP for the team; do not remove his MP
mech.wanted.maitre-boulet.retrait-pm.summary: No invulnerability. For the whole fight, your characters have 2 fewer MP; each MP removal attempt gives him 2 MP, 100 power and 20 pushback damage for 1 turn (stackable).

mech.wanted.maitre-boulet.distance.title: Stay more than 6 range away; weak to neutral
mech.wanted.maitre-boulet.distance.summary: He only hits in melee (neutral, earth): more than 6 range away (5 MP + melee) he cannot hit you directly. He has 10% neutral weakness. Kill his Tournesol affamé (100 HP, every 4 turns) if the fight drags on.
mech.wanted.maitre-boulet.distance.notes.0: His special poison hits earth if you are healed and removes 1 MP if you are moved.
mech.wanted.maitre-boulet.distance.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.maitre-boulet.distance.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Bring characters who hit neutral, playing with 2 fewer MP.
mech.wanted.maitre-boulet.distance.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: 10% neutral weakness; Boulétisation removes 2 MP (infinite) from your characters.
mech.wanted.maitre-boulet.distance.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Stay more than 6 range from him.
mech.wanted.maitre-boulet.distance.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: He only hits in melee (5 base MP + melee): he will never be able to hit you directly.
mech.wanted.maitre-boulet.distance.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Never try to remove his MP.
mech.wanted.maitre-boulet.distance.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: Each attempt gives him 2 MP, 100 Power and 20 pushback damage for 1 turn (stackable).
mech.wanted.maitre-boulet.distance.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Kill his Tournesol each time it is summoned (100 HP), especially in a small team.
mech.wanted.maitre-boulet.distance.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Watch out for Débitage effects on a hit character.
mech.wanted.maitre-boulet.distance.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: For 1 turn, each heal received hits them for earth (6 to 10) and each forced movement removes 1 MP from them.

mech.wanted.maitre-boulet.allies-de-circ.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.maitre-boulet.allies-de-circ.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -80 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.marzwel-le-gobelin.malus-tac.title: -10 lock to the whole team for the whole fight
mech.wanted.marzwel-le-gobelin.malus-tac.summary: No invulnerability. From the start, he removes 10 lock from all your characters for the whole fight; he can gain dodge and range, steal MP, push back and remove power.
mech.wanted.marzwel-le-gobelin.malus-tac.unknownAspects.0: The page gives no tactical advice.

mech.wanted.marzwel-le-gobelin.allies-de.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.marzwel-le-gobelin.allies-de.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -250 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.maxi-malle.gonflette.title: "Gonflette": do not push her, few damage lines
mech.wanted.maxi-malle.gonflette.summary: No invulnerability. Each pushback gives her 1 MP (infinite, stackable) and each damage line taken increases the base damage of "Décoffrage Brut" (melee) by 10. Use powerful single-line spells, stay at range (MP removal possible) or finish her in one turn.
mech.wanted.maxi-malle.gonflette.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.maxi-malle.gonflette.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: Gonflette: +1 MP (infinite and stackable) on each pushback.
mech.wanted.maxi-malle.gonflette.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Stay far enough from her once the focus has started; if possible, remove her MP.
mech.wanted.maxi-malle.gonflette.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Décoffrage Brut (melee) hits ~120 air life steal in a radius-2 circle, pushes back 2 cells and applies -200 Power.
mech.wanted.maxi-malle.gonflette.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Hit her with powerful spells that have a single damage line.
mech.wanted.maxi-malle.gonflette.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: Each damage line increases the base damage of Décoffrage Brut by 10 (infinite and stackable).
mech.wanted.maxi-malle.gonflette.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Ideally, finish her off in a single turn.
mech.wanted.maxi-malle.gonflette.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: The guide mentions it as a way to work around the Décoffrage Brut boost.
mech.wanted.maxi-malle.gonflette.sequences.0.steps.5.action: At range, be wary of Macro-Ondes.
mech.wanted.maxi-malle.gonflette.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: Macro-Ondes (up to 8 range) hits in a radius-2 circle, steals 2 MP and applies Pesanteur.

mech.wanted.maxi-malle.allies-de-circons.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.maxi-malle.allies-de-circons.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -600 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with her. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.mogligli.invocation.title: Random invulnerable summon (Balours, Bagarra or Mulibre)
mech.wanted.mogligli.invocation.summary: No invulnerability for Mogligli. At the start of the fight, he randomly summons Balours (Pesanteur, dodge/MP removal in radius 3), Bagarra (air melee hit with place swap) or Mulibre (shields), invulnerable for the whole fight. Stay away from the first two.
mech.wanted.mogligli.invocation.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.mogligli.invocation.sequences.0.steps.1.action: At launch: count the monsters accompanying Mogligli.
mech.wanted.mogligli.invocation.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Alliés de circonstance": he loses 1100 vitality (infinite) per monster present with him; alone in the fight, he has no penalty.
mech.wanted.mogligli.invocation.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Start of the fight: identify which summon he brought out (Balours, Bagarra or Mulibre). Do not try to kill it.
mech.wanted.mogligli.invocation.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Le livre de la Lande" randomly summons one of the three, Invulnerable for the whole fight. Mogligli himself has no Invulnerable state.
mech.wanted.mogligli.invocation.sequences.0.steps.3.action: If it is Balours: stay more than 3 cells from him.
mech.wanted.mogligli.invocation.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Landes Hostiles": Pesanteur for 1 turn, -20 Dodge and -2 MP (dodgeable) in a radius-3 circle around him.
mech.wanted.mogligli.invocation.sequences.0.steps.4.action: If it is Bagarra: do not stay adjacent to him.
mech.wanted.mogligli.invocation.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: "Panthair": swaps places with the target and hits 300 air, melee only.
mech.wanted.mogligli.invocation.sequences.0.steps.5.action: If it is Mulibre: ignore it and hit Mogligli.
mech.wanted.mogligli.invocation.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: Mulibre only gives shield points (10% of HP, 1 turn) to monsters within 3 range; you are not at risk.
mech.wanted.mogligli.invocation.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Do not line up your characters with each other.
mech.wanted.mogligli.invocation.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: "Au Kanig !" (in line up to 4 range) pushes back by 6 cells all characters in an infinite perpendicular line with the target: risk of being pushed far away.
mech.wanted.mogligli.invocation.sequences.0.steps.7.action: Do not stay adjacent to Mogligli.
mech.wanted.mogligli.invocation.sequences.0.steps.8.rationale: "La chasse de Kaa-Kaa" (5-turn cooldown) reveals invisible characters and boosts all monsters by 2 MP, 20 Lock and 20 Dodge for 2 turns.

mech.wanted.mogligli.poussee-ligne.title: Do not stay in line with your allies
mech.wanted.mogligli.poussee-ligne.summary: One of his spells pushes back by 6 cells the characters in line with the target.
mech.wanted.mogligli.poussee-ligne.unknownAspects.0: Ambiguous wording: it is unclear whether "6 cells" refers to the length of the line or only to the pushback.

mech.wanted.mogligli.allies-de-circonsta.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.mogligli.allies-de-circonsta.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -1100 vitality (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.tour-1.title: Turn 1: immobilized, use it to buff up
mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.tour-1.summary: No invulnerability. On the first turn only, all your characters lose 100 MP and are in Pesanteur (not debuffable): use this turn to buff up.
mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.tour-1.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.tour-1.sequences.0.steps.1.action: At launch: count the monsters accompanying him.
mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.tour-1.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Alliés de circonstance": -900 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him; alone, no penalty.
mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.tour-1.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Turn 1: do not try to move, use the whole turn to buff up.
mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.tour-1.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Gentleman du crime": on turn 1 only, all your characters lose 100 MP and are in Pesanteur (not debuffable).
mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.tour-1.sequences.0.steps.3.action: From turn 2: stand more than 6 range from Monsieur Pingouin and stay there.
mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.tour-1.sequences.0.steps.3.position: More than 6 range from the boss
mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.tour-1.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Parapluie Gadget" (melee, size-1 cross) can randomly make you skip your turn; 6 range = his 4 base MP + range 2.
mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.tour-1.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Watch the monsters that can bring him closer to you or bring you closer to him.
mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.tour-1.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: The Mamansot can give him 2 MP; the Mansobèse (5 range) and the Timansot (10 range) swap positions with a character and push back in melee.
mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.tour-1.sequences.0.steps.5.action: When an ally receives "Mise en scène trompeuse": move the others more than 6 range away from them if they cannot tank it.
mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.tour-1.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: "Mascarade Rocambolesque": for 1 turn, that character intercepts the damage of all their allies in a radius-6 circle.
mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.tour-1.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Hit Monsieur Pingouin while accounting for his heals.
mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.tour-1.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: "Iceberg Saloon" (4-turn cooldown): heal of 400 HP and reduction of 5 (actual 37 per hit) for 3 turns in a radius-4 circle.

mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.distances.title: More than 6 range from him and from the ally under "Mise en scène trompeuse"
mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.distances.summary: His adjacent cross spell can make you skip your turn: stay more than 6 range away (4 MP + range 2). The "Mise en scène trompeuse" effect (1 turn) makes a character intercept the damage of their allies within 6 range: move away from them if they cannot tank it.
mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.distances.notes.0: Mamansot (+2 MP), Mansobèse and Timansot (place swaps, pushbacks) can bring you closer to him.

mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.allies-de-.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.monsieur-pingouin.allies-de-.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -900 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.morblok.repartition.title: -30% damage, damage sharing and penalties by element: hit with water or fire at range
mech.wanted.morblok.repartition.summary: No invulnerability. He reduces all damage taken by 30%, shares 50% of damage taken within radius 2 around him, and punishes the attacker and their neighbours (radius 2) depending on the element: water -1 AP, fire -4 effect duration, air -50 power, earth/neutral 50% sharing. The guide advises water or fire and staying more than 2 range from him.
mech.wanted.morblok.repartition.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.morblok.repartition.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Before entering: bring characters who hit with Water or Fire.
mech.wanted.morblok.repartition.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: He has the most resistance in Earth, Neutral and Air; Earth/Neutral sends 50% of the damage back onto you and around you, Air gives you -50 power. Water (-1 AP) and Fire (-4 effect duration) are much less restrictive.
mech.wanted.morblok.repartition.sequences.0.steps.2.action: At launch: count the monsters accompanying him.
mech.wanted.morblok.repartition.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Alliés de circonstance": -800 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him.
mech.wanted.morblok.repartition.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Stand and stay more than 2 range from Morblok.
mech.wanted.morblok.repartition.sequences.0.steps.3.position: More than 2 range from the boss
mech.wanted.morblok.repartition.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Fragmentation" shares 50% of the damage he takes with everyone within radius 2 around him, and you would hinder the allies hitting him.
mech.wanted.morblok.repartition.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Hit only with Water or Fire, without standing next to your allies.
mech.wanted.morblok.repartition.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: "Armure réfléchissante" punishes the attacker and everyone within radius 2 around them depending on the element; he also reduces all damage taken by 30% for the whole fight.
mech.wanted.morblok.repartition.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Do not stay adjacent to Morblok.
mech.wanted.morblok.repartition.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: "Rajeunissement" hits 150 fire in melee and heals him for about 160 HP; "Saute-heure" teleports him (5 range), pulls 3 cells and hits in a radius-3 circle.

mech.wanted.morblok.allies-de-circonstan.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.morblok.allies-de-circonstan.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -800 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.musha-l-oni.devoile.title: Reveals invisible characters at the start of each turn
mech.wanted.musha-l-oni.devoile.summary: No invulnerability. At the start of each of his turns, he makes all invisible characters visible: invisibility (Sram) is useless. He can also debuff, maximize your random effects, remove range, swap places and apply Affaibli.
mech.wanted.musha-l-oni.devoile.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.musha-l-oni.devoile.sequences.0.steps.1.action: At launch: count the monsters accompanying him.
mech.wanted.musha-l-oni.devoile.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Alliés de circonstance": -400 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him.
mech.wanted.musha-l-oni.devoile.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Onictifiant" (infinite) reveals all invisible characters at the start of each of his turns.
mech.wanted.musha-l-oni.devoile.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Plan to recast your buffs: he can debuff you.
mech.wanted.musha-l-oni.devoile.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Onigaud" (12 range, 3-turn cooldown) debuffs, applies a neutral poison for 4 turns and maximizes your random effects for 1 turn.
mech.wanted.musha-l-oni.devoile.sequences.0.steps.4.action: After an "Onigaud", protect the hit character.
mech.wanted.musha-l-oni.devoile.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: Monsters will roll their maximum values on the character with this effect for 1 turn.
mech.wanted.musha-l-oni.devoile.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Anticipate range loss and place swaps.
mech.wanted.musha-l-oni.devoile.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: "Onivoirien" (12 range) removes 4 range (6 on crit) and applies Affaibli for 1 turn; "Onigiri" (6 range) swaps positions with the target.

mech.wanted.musha-l-oni.allies-de-circon.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.musha-l-oni.allies-de-circon.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -400 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.naganita.pacifiste.title: Pacifiste beyond 2 range: stay within radius 2 at the start of her turn
mech.wanted.naganita.pacifiste.summary: No invulnerability. At the start of her turn, characters more than 2 range away become Pacifiste (infinite) and she heals 200 HP per character or summon more than 2 range away. At exactly 3 range, the state toggles (removed if present, applied otherwise). She then pushes back by 6 cells those within radius 3: place an obstacle or a static summon behind you, and avoid summoning.
mech.wanted.naganita.pacifiste.sequences.0.label: Avoid Pacifiste
mech.wanted.naganita.pacifiste.sequences.0.steps.1.action: End your turn 2 range or less from Naganita.
mech.wanted.naganita.pacifiste.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Place an obstacle or a static summon behind you.

mech.wanted.naganita.allies-de-circonsta.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.naganita.allies-de-circonsta.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -600 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with her. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.nufor.title: Kill the first Nufor as soon as it is summoned
mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.nufor.summary: No invulnerability. He summons a static Nufor (1000 HP) that summons 4 after one turn, then 8 after two (12 maximum); only the Nufor summoned by Nenufor multiplies. "Rhizome agressif" (fire, -2 MP) repeats for each Nufor in the character's line of sight.
mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.nufor.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.nufor.sequences.0.steps.1.action: At launch: count the monsters accompanying him.
mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.nufor.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Alliés de circonstance": -800 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him.
mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.nufor.sequences.0.steps.2.action: As soon as he summons a Nufor: kill it immediately.
mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.nufor.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: This Nufor (1000 HP, static) summons 4 after 1 turn, then 8 after 2 turns; only the one summoned by Nenufor multiplies.
mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.nufor.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Do not stay in the line of sight of several Nufors.
mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.nufor.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Rhizome agressif" (100 fire in radius 3, -2 MP) is applied again as many times as there are Nufors in the character's line of sight.
mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.nufor.sequences.0.steps.4.action: End each turn more than 4 range from Nenufor.
mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.nufor.sequences.0.steps.4.position: More than 4 range from the boss
mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.nufor.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: "Spores de Nymphéacée" makes him hit 120 earth within radius 4 around him at the start of his next turn.
mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.nufor.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Get out of the green glyph.
mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.nufor.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: The radius-4 green glyph removes up to 6 MP (dodgeable).
mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.nufor.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Go back to step 2 at each new Nufor summon.
mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.nufor.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: He summons a Nufor every 2 turns (2-turn cooldown).

mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.glyphe-vert.title: Stay more than 4 range away at the start of his turn
mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.glyphe-vert.summary: Each turn he places a radius-4 green glyph (up to 6 MP removed) and hits earth within radius 4 at the start of his next turn.

mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.allies-de-ci.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.nenufor-tilotus.allies-de-ci.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -800 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.nono-le-wobot.reduction.title: Melee and weapon reduction: use ranged spells
mech.wanted.nono-le-wobot.reduction.summary: No invulnerability. He reduces melee and weapon damage by 10 (actual reduction of 40 per hit), combined to 80 for a weapon in melee: hit with ranged spells.
mech.wanted.nono-le-wobot.reduction.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.nono-le-wobot.reduction.sequences.0.steps.1.action: At launch: count the monsters accompanying him.
mech.wanted.nono-le-wobot.reduction.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Alliés de circonstance": -250 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him.
mech.wanted.nono-le-wobot.reduction.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Stand and stay more than 4 range from Nono.
mech.wanted.nono-le-wobot.reduction.sequences.0.steps.2.position: More than 4 range from the boss
mech.wanted.nono-le-wobot.reduction.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Massue matwaquante" (melee) removes 100% neutral resistance for 4 turns, stackable 2 times; 4 range = his 3 base MP + range.
mech.wanted.nono-le-wobot.reduction.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Hit him only with ranged spells, never with a weapon.
mech.wanted.nono-le-wobot.reduction.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Pwotection wappwochée": -40 per hit in melee or with a weapon, -80 with a weapon in melee.
