mech.wanted.nono-le-wobot.reduction.sequences.0.steps.4.action: If you are invisible: stay more than 3 range from your allies.
mech.wanted.nono-le-wobot.reduction.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: The character under "Vewwouillage" makes their allies within radius 3 visible at the start of their turn.
mech.wanted.nono-le-wobot.reduction.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Do not group your characters around the Vewwouillé one.
mech.wanted.nono-le-wobot.reduction.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: "Wavelot explosif" hits in radius 3; on a Vewwouillé target it hits harder, removes 4 MP and places a radius-3 green glyph (100 fire) for 2 turns.

mech.wanted.nono-le-wobot.distance.title: More than 4 range from him; invisible characters more than 3 range from allies
mech.wanted.nono-le-wobot.distance.summary: In melee, he removes 100% neutral resistance for 4 turns (stackable): stay more than 4 range away (3 MP + range). The character under "Vewwouillage" makes their allies within 3 range visible at the start of their turn.

mech.wanted.nono-le-wobot.allies-de-circ.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.nono-le-wobot.allies-de-circ.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -250 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.ogivol-scalarcin.esquive-mel.title: Dodges 100% of melee hits: hit him at range
mech.wanted.ogivol-scalarcin.esquive-mel.summary: No invulnerable state, but he dodges all melee hits by stepping back one cell: you must hit him at range. Stay more than 8 range away (range 4 + 4 MP), 9 range when he becomes invisible (+1 MP for 4 turns), so you never get hit.
mech.wanted.ogivol-scalarcin.esquive-mel.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.ogivol-scalarcin.esquive-mel.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Before entering: bring characters who hit at range.
mech.wanted.ogivol-scalarcin.esquive-mel.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Ogivoltige": he dodges 100% of melee hits by stepping back 1 cell, for the whole fight.
mech.wanted.ogivol-scalarcin.esquive-mel.sequences.0.steps.2.action: At launch: count the monsters accompanying him.
mech.wanted.ogivol-scalarcin.esquive-mel.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Alliés de circonstance": -200 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him.
mech.wanted.ogivol-scalarcin.esquive-mel.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Stand and stay more than 8 range from Ogivol.
mech.wanted.ogivol-scalarcin.esquive-mel.sequences.0.steps.3.position: More than 8 range from the boss
mech.wanted.ogivol-scalarcin.esquive-mel.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: His longest-range spell reaches 4 range, + his 4 base MP: he will never be able to hit you.
mech.wanted.ogivol-scalarcin.esquive-mel.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Never hit him in melee: only at range.
mech.wanted.ogivol-scalarcin.esquive-mel.sequences.0.steps.5.action: When he becomes invisible: move to 9 range from him.
mech.wanted.ogivol-scalarcin.esquive-mel.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: "Ogivolatilisé" (7-turn cooldown) makes him invisible for 3 turns and gives him +1 MP for 4 turns.
mech.wanted.ogivol-scalarcin.esquive-mel.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Do not stay adjacent to him.
mech.wanted.ogivol-scalarcin.esquive-mel.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: "Ogivolage" hits air and earth, steals Agility and Strength and applies erosion to all characters adjacent to him.

mech.wanted.ogivol-scalarcin.allies-de-c.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.ogivol-scalarcin.allies-de-c.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -200 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.padgref-demoel.frappe-melee.title: Hit for 30% of his vitality (turn 3 then every 2 turns): stay very far away
mech.wanted.padgref-demoel.frappe-melee.summary: No invulnerability. From turn 3 and then every 2 turns, he hits in melee for 30% of his maximum vitality (up to 4800). Since he swaps places with his monsters and pulls by 5 cells, ideally stay more than 11 range from him and his monsters from turn 3. Staying 3 range or more from each monster avoids the water hit of his swap.
mech.wanted.padgref-demoel.frappe-melee.notes.0: Each time he is hit, he gains 100 strength, agility, chance and intelligence for 5 turns (once per turn).
mech.wanted.padgref-demoel.frappe-melee.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.padgref-demoel.frappe-melee.sequences.0.steps.1.action: At launch: count the monsters accompanying him.
mech.wanted.padgref-demoel.frappe-melee.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Alliés de circonstance": -900 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him.
mech.wanted.padgref-demoel.frappe-melee.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Stay 3 range or more from every monster in the fight.
mech.wanted.padgref-demoel.frappe-melee.sequences.0.steps.2.position: 3 range or more from every monster
mech.wanted.padgref-demoel.frappe-melee.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Transposition aqueuse" (14 range, 4-turn cooldown): he swaps places with a monster and hits 200 water in a radius-2 circle around his arrival position.
mech.wanted.padgref-demoel.frappe-melee.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Turns 1 and 2: stay at least more than 6 range from him.
mech.wanted.padgref-demoel.frappe-melee.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: His 5 base MP + his melee range.
mech.wanted.padgref-demoel.frappe-melee.sequences.0.steps.4.action: From turn 3: stay more than 11 range from Padgref and the monsters accompanying him.
mech.wanted.padgref-demoel.frappe-melee.sequences.0.steps.4.position: More than 11 range from the boss and his monsters
mech.wanted.padgref-demoel.frappe-melee.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: "Sanction" hits for 30% of his maximum vitality (up to 4800) in melee from turn 3, and he can swap places with a monster and pull you by 5 cells ("Attraction", in line, infinite range).
mech.wanted.padgref-demoel.frappe-melee.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: "Attraction" can only be cast in line at infinite range; "Assaut aérien" in line up to 3 range.
mech.wanted.padgref-demoel.frappe-melee.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Keep this distance for the whole fight.
mech.wanted.padgref-demoel.frappe-melee.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: "Sanction" has a 2-turn cooldown: it comes back every 2 turns.

mech.wanted.padgref-demoel.allies-de-cir.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.padgref-demoel.allies-de-cir.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -900 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.prince-marchand.invulnerable.title: -100% resistance to invulnerable characters
mech.wanted.prince-marchand.invulnerable.summary: No invulnerability. He can remove 100% resistance for 2 turns, only from characters with an invulnerable state (normal, ranged or melee). He also periodically maximizes random effects against you (every 1 to 3 turns).

mech.wanted.prince-marchand.distance.title: Stay at range and spread out; avoid neutral
mech.wanted.prince-marchand.distance.summary: He only hits in a size-1 cross when adjacent (random element) but moves a lot (MP steal, 2-cell pull): stay spread out so he only hits one character. 50% neutral resistance.
mech.wanted.prince-marchand.distance.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.prince-marchand.distance.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Before entering: avoid characters who hit with Neutral.
mech.wanted.prince-marchand.distance.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: The Prince Marchand has 50% Neutral resistance.
mech.wanted.prince-marchand.distance.sequences.0.steps.2.action: At launch: count the monsters accompanying him.
mech.wanted.prince-marchand.distance.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Alliés de circonstance": -600 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him.
mech.wanted.prince-marchand.distance.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Stay at range from the Prince and keep your characters spread out from each other.
mech.wanted.prince-marchand.distance.sequences.0.steps.3.position: Characters not next to each other
mech.wanted.prince-marchand.distance.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Palouf" hits in a size-1 cross when adjacent and boosts him by 50 power and damage reduction per target hit (stackable).
mech.wanted.prince-marchand.distance.sequences.0.steps.4.action: If he gets adjacent, make sure he only hits one character.
mech.wanted.prince-marchand.distance.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: He moves a lot: MP steal ("Marchandage", 8 range) and "Charge Héroïque" which pulls him 2 cells onto the target.
mech.wanted.prince-marchand.distance.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Do not stand next to him with an Invulnerable state.
mech.wanted.prince-marchand.distance.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: "Palouf" removes 100% resistance (150 on crit) for 2 turns if the target has an Invulnerable state (normal, ranged or melee).
mech.wanted.prince-marchand.distance.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Do not stay near him when "Vente forcée" triggers.
mech.wanted.prince-marchand.distance.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: Every 1, 2 or 3 turns (random), he maximizes your random effects in an area around him (cross 1, 3x3 square or radius-2 circle).

mech.wanted.prince-marchand.allies-de-ci.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.prince-marchand.allies-de-ci.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -600 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.qil-bil.bouclier.title: Do not push him or remove his MP; avoid traps and glyphs
mech.wanted.qil-bil.bouclier.summary: No invulnerability. Each pushback or MP removal attempt gives him a shield of 10% of his remaining HP. 3 turns out of 4, trap or glyph damage boosts his power.
mech.wanted.qil-bil.bouclier.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.qil-bil.bouclier.sequences.0.steps.1.action: At launch: count the monsters accompanying him.
mech.wanted.qil-bil.bouclier.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Alliés de circonstance": -300 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him.
mech.wanted.qil-bil.bouclier.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Cyberbwork": each pushback gives him 10% of his remaining HP as shield points (infinite).
mech.wanted.qil-bil.bouclier.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Never try to remove his MP.
mech.wanted.qil-bil.bouclier.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: Same effect: each MP removal attempt gives him 10% of his remaining HP as shield points.
mech.wanted.qil-bil.bouclier.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Do not place traps or glyphs.
mech.wanted.qil-bil.bouclier.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: 3 turns out of 4 ("Rage cybernétique"), trap or glyph damage boosts his power and damage.
mech.wanted.qil-bil.bouclier.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Do not stay adjacent to him or in line at 2 range from him.
mech.wanted.qil-bil.bouclier.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: "Surchauffe" hits 100 fire when adjacent and pushes back 3 cells; "Lancer de poing" (in line up to 2 range) hits 350 neutral and removes 2 AP.

mech.wanted.qil-bil.allies-de-circonstan.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.qil-bil.allies-de-circonstan.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -300 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.roi-camole.cactrucs.title: Cactrucs: power boost and adjacent hits
mech.wanted.roi-camole.cactrucs.summary: No invulnerability. He gains 8 power per turn, plus 8 per Cactruc present. He can make a target Cacterrorisée and summon 16 Cactrucs in his lines and diagonals. An attacked Cactruc hits its neighbours, and his air spell hits characters adjacent to a Cactruc. Do not stay next to Cactrucs or hit one next to an ally (unless one-shot in a single line); kill as many as possible before his turn, or focus him directly.
mech.wanted.roi-camole.cactrucs.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.roi-camole.cactrucs.sequences.0.steps.1.action: At launch: count the monsters accompanying him.
mech.wanted.roi-camole.cactrucs.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Alliés de circonstance": -900 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him.
mech.wanted.roi-camole.cactrucs.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Stay more than 7 MP from him (less if you remove his MP).
mech.wanted.roi-camole.cactrucs.sequences.0.steps.2.position: More than 7 MP from the boss
mech.wanted.roi-camole.cactrucs.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Épines et Mirages" (melee) hits 250 earth, pushes back 4 cells and makes him invisible for 1 turn; he has 5 base MP.
mech.wanted.roi-camole.cactrucs.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Do not stay adjacent to a Cactruc.
mech.wanted.roi-camole.cactrucs.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Coucalactus" also hits for 200 air the characters adjacent to a Cactruc or to a Cacterrorisé character within radius 4 around the target.
mech.wanted.roi-camole.cactrucs.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Do not hit a Cactruc that is next to an ally, unless you kill it with a single damage line.
mech.wanted.roi-camole.cactrucs.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: A Cactruc that is hit strikes the characters on its adjacent cells (60 earth).
mech.wanted.roi-camole.cactrucs.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Eliminate as many Cactrucs as possible before the Roi Camole's turn.
mech.wanted.roi-camole.cactrucs.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: "Piktature": +8 power every turn, plus 8 per Cactruc present at the start of his turn.
mech.wanted.roi-camole.cactrucs.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Alternative: ignore the Cactrucs and focus the Roi Camole to kill him as fast as possible.
mech.wanted.roi-camole.cactrucs.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: The guide also suggests keeping the Cactrucs if you can tank his damage once he is boosted.
mech.wanted.roi-camole.cactrucs.sequences.0.steps.7.action: Go back to step 3 at each new "Forêt de Cactus".
mech.wanted.roi-camole.cactrucs.sequences.0.steps.7.rationale: "Forêt de Cactus" (2-turn cooldown) makes the target Cacterrorisée for 1 turn and places 1500 HP Cactrucs in line and diagonal.

mech.wanted.roi-camole.melee.title: Do not let him hit in melee (invisibility)
mech.wanted.roi-camole.melee.summary: His melee spell makes him invisible: stay more than 7 MP from him (5 base MP), less if you remove his MP.
mech.wanted.roi-camole.melee.unknownAspects.0: The guide writes "7PM" where a distance in range seems intended.

mech.wanted.roi-camole.allies-de-circons.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.roi-camole.allies-de-circons.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -900 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.rok-gnorok.puissance.title: +20 power per turn: kill him fast, debuff him
mech.wanted.rok-gnorok.puissance.summary: No invulnerability. He gains 20 power (infinite, stackable) at the start of each turn. Two turns out of three he reduces his damage taken (debuffable). Being more than 8 range away (5 MP + range 3) at the start of his turn avoids all his spells.
mech.wanted.rok-gnorok.puissance.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.rok-gnorok.puissance.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Before entering: if possible, bring a character who can debuff.
mech.wanted.rok-gnorok.puissance.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: Two turns out of three, "Armure rocailleuse" reduces his damage taken by 15 (actual 82 per hit); the effect is cancelled by debuffing him.
mech.wanted.rok-gnorok.puissance.sequences.0.steps.2.action: At launch: count the monsters accompanying him.
mech.wanted.rok-gnorok.puissance.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Alliés de circonstance": -500 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him.
mech.wanted.rok-gnorok.puissance.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Be more than 8 range from Rok Gnorok at the start of each of his turns.
mech.wanted.rok-gnorok.puissance.sequences.0.steps.3.position: More than 8 range from the boss
mech.wanted.rok-gnorok.puissance.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: His 5 base MP + the range 3 of his longest spell: you avoid all his spells, including the power penalty of "Surt".
mech.wanted.rok-gnorok.puissance.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Focus damage to kill him fast.
mech.wanted.rok-gnorok.puissance.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: "Bientôt la fin": +20 power (infinite, stackable) at the start of each of his turns, he hits harder and harder.
mech.wanted.rok-gnorok.puissance.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Debuff him as soon as he reduces his damage taken.
mech.wanted.rok-gnorok.puissance.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: The reduction lasts 2 turns (3-turn cooldown) and also applies to his allies adjacent to him.

mech.wanted.rok-gnorok.allies-de-circons.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.rok-gnorok.allies-de-circons.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -500 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.roub-ignolles.bombes.title: Bomb'Ignolles: kill them or stay more than 3 range away
mech.wanted.roub-ignolles.bombes.summary: No invulnerability. Each turn he summons bombs at 1 range in his diagonals (4 maximum); they explode after 4 turns or on death, harder and wider (up to radius 3) over time. He can swap places with a bomb to make it explode on the next turn. Either kill the 4 bombs each turn (without being adjacent to them), or stay more than 3 range from each one; do not stand at 1 range diagonally from him.
mech.wanted.roub-ignolles.bombes.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.roub-ignolles.bombes.sequences.0.steps.1.action: At launch: count the monsters accompanying him.
mech.wanted.roub-ignolles.bombes.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Alliés de circonstance": -150 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him.
mech.wanted.roub-ignolles.bombes.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Never stand at 1 range diagonally from Roub' Ignolles.
mech.wanted.roub-ignolles.bombes.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: He summons his bombs at 1 range in his diagonals; a character on the summon cell takes 100 water.
mech.wanted.roub-ignolles.bombes.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Choose a method: kill the 4 bombs each turn, OR leave them and keep away from them.
mech.wanted.roub-ignolles.bombes.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: If you do not kill them, he does not summon new ones (4 maximum); if you kill them, he summons more at the start of each of his turns.
mech.wanted.roub-ignolles.bombes.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Method 1: kill the 4 bombs as soon as they are summoned, without being adjacent to them.
mech.wanted.roub-ignolles.bombes.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: A bomb killed on the turn it is summoned only explodes in a size-1 cross (50 fire). Useful if you are short on HP.
mech.wanted.roub-ignolles.bombes.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Method 2: stay more than 3 range from each bomb.
mech.wanted.roub-ignolles.bombes.sequences.0.steps.5.position: More than 3 range from each bomb
mech.wanted.roub-ignolles.bombes.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: A bomb explodes at most in a radius-3 circle, and on its own after 4 turns.
mech.wanted.roub-ignolles.bombes.sequences.0.steps.6.action: In both cases, do not group the team around him.
mech.wanted.roub-ignolles.bombes.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: "Téléportabombe" (10 range): he swaps places with a bomb, which explodes on its next turn as if it were its last turn.

mech.wanted.roub-ignolles.allies-de-circ.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.roub-ignolles.allies-de-circ.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -150 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.simbadas.malus-po-mort.title: -10 range for the team; each death strengthens him
mech.wanted.simbadas.malus-po-mort.summary: No invulnerability. From the start, all your characters lose 10 range for the whole fight. Each dead character gives him 4 MP and 400 power (infinite, stackable): keep everyone alive.
mech.wanted.simbadas.malus-po-mort.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.simbadas.malus-po-mort.sequences.0.steps.1.action: At launch: count the monsters accompanying him.
mech.wanted.simbadas.malus-po-mort.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Alliés de circonstance": -500 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him.
mech.wanted.simbadas.malus-po-mort.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Start of the fight: play accounting for -10 range on all your characters.
mech.wanted.simbadas.malus-po-mort.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Appel de la faim" removes 10 range from all your characters for the whole fight.
mech.wanted.simbadas.malus-po-mort.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Soif de Sang": each dead character gives him 4 MP and 400 power (infinite, stackable).
mech.wanted.simbadas.malus-po-mort.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Do not stay grouped within range of his jump.
mech.wanted.simbadas.malus-po-mort.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: "Saut précipité" (in line from 2 to 6 range) teleports him and hits 120 neutral in a radius-2 circle around his arrival position, with -20 Dodge.
mech.wanted.simbadas.malus-po-mort.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: "Grosse papatte" (melee) hits 250 earth life steal in a size-3 perpendicular line and poisons for 2 turns.

mech.wanted.simbadas.allies-de-circonsta.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.simbadas.allies-de-circonsta.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -500 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.tournade.distance.title: Keep her at range (Pacifiste at 2 range)
mech.wanted.tournade.distance.summary: No invulnerability. Within radius 2 around her, she removes 10 range, applies Pacifiste and poisons with air: stay at least 7 range away (4 base MP). She hits at short range (2 and 5 range) but pulls from up to 8 range; pushing her back makes her harmless. She gains 620 HP (3 turns) per character hit within radius 5: do not group up there.
mech.wanted.tournade.distance.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.tournade.distance.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Before entering: favour characters who hit with Water.
mech.wanted.tournade.distance.sequences.0.steps.2.action: At launch: count the monsters accompanying her.
mech.wanted.tournade.distance.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Alliés de circonstance": -400 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with her.
mech.wanted.tournade.distance.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Stay at least 7 range from Tournade (less if you remove her MP).
mech.wanted.tournade.distance.sequences.0.steps.3.position: 7 range or more from the boss
mech.wanted.tournade.distance.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Tempête Dévastatrice" applies Pacifiste, removes 10 range and poisons with air within radius 2; she has 4 base MP.
mech.wanted.tournade.distance.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Push her back to keep her at range, then hit her.
mech.wanted.tournade.distance.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: Her hits are short-range (2 and 5 range): kept at range, she can do nothing.
mech.wanted.tournade.distance.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Watch out for the 6 to 8 range zone around her.
mech.wanted.tournade.distance.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: "Aspiration de masse" pulls 3 cells, steals 2 MP and applies -50% resistance for 2 turns to enemies within a radius of 6 to 8.
mech.wanted.tournade.distance.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Do not have several characters within radius 5 around her.
mech.wanted.tournade.distance.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: "Tourbillon violent" (300 air life steal, radius 5) gives her 620 HP for 3 turns per character in the area.

mech.wanted.tournade.allies-de-circonsta.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.tournade.allies-de-circonsta.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -400 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with her. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.trukipik.pacifiste.title: Pacifiste beyond 2 range: stay within radius 2 at the start of his turn
mech.wanted.trukipik.pacifiste.summary: No invulnerability. At the start of his turn, characters more than 2 range away become Pacifiste (infinite) and he heals 200 HP per character or summon more than 2 range away. At exactly 3 range, the state toggles. He pushes back by 6 cells those within radius 3 (except in the Duel state): place an obstacle or a static summon behind you, avoid summoning.
mech.wanted.trukipik.pacifiste.notes.0: His neutral melee hit applies Duel, which on the next turn adds a hit of 200% of the target's eroded HP.
mech.wanted.trukipik.pacifiste.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.trukipik.pacifiste.sequences.0.steps.1.action: At launch: count the monsters accompanying him.
mech.wanted.trukipik.pacifiste.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Alliés de circonstance": -600 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him.
mech.wanted.trukipik.pacifiste.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Do not summon (or only summons that stay near him).
mech.wanted.trukipik.pacifiste.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: He heals 200 HP per character or summon more than 2 range from him at the start of his turn.
mech.wanted.trukipik.pacifiste.sequences.0.steps.3.action: End each turn within 2 range of Trukipik.
mech.wanted.trukipik.pacifiste.sequences.0.steps.3.position: 2 range or less from the boss
mech.wanted.trukipik.pacifiste.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Combat Rapproché": at the start of his turn, characters more than 2 range away become Pacifiste (infinite).
mech.wanted.trukipik.pacifiste.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Do not end your turn at exactly 3 range, unless to lose the Pacifiste state.
mech.wanted.trukipik.pacifiste.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: At 3 range, if you are Pacifiste you lose it, otherwise you become Pacifiste.
mech.wanted.trukipik.pacifiste.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Place a map obstacle or a static summon (e.g. a cawotte) behind your characters, at 3 range from him.
mech.wanted.trukipik.pacifiste.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: "Puissant balayage" pushes back by 6 cells the characters within radius 3 (except in the Duel state).
mech.wanted.trukipik.pacifiste.sequences.0.steps.6.action: Watch out for the character hit by "Estoc fatal".
mech.wanted.trukipik.pacifiste.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: They enter the Duel state; on the next turn, "Estoc fatal" adds a neutral hit of 200% of their eroded HP.
mech.wanted.trukipik.pacifiste.sequences.0.steps.7.rationale: The "Combat Rapproché" effect triggers every turn.

mech.wanted.trukipik.allies-de-circonsta.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.trukipik.allies-de-circonsta.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -600 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.tyranne-la-terrible.echange-.title: Place swap on every hit; chain pushbacks
mech.wanted.tyranne-la-terrible.echange-.summary: No invulnerability. Any character who deals damage to her swaps places with her. Taking pushback damage pushes the character and those adjacent to them back by 6 cells. She gains pushback damage based on the number of characters around her: do not stay grouped.
mech.wanted.tyranne-la-terrible.echange-.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.tyranne-la-terrible.echange-.sequences.0.steps.1.action: At launch: count the monsters accompanying her.
mech.wanted.tyranne-la-terrible.echange-.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Alliés de circonstance": -400 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with her.
mech.wanted.tyranne-la-terrible.echange-.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Before each hit, expect your character to swap places with Tyranne.
mech.wanted.tyranne-la-terrible.echange-.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Pression constante": for each damage line you deal to her, she swaps positions with your character.
mech.wanted.tyranne-la-terrible.echange-.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Do not hit her with a spell that pushes her towards you.
mech.wanted.tyranne-la-terrible.echange-.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: Example from the guide: an Iop hits and pushes her, they swap places, she is pushed back onto him; he takes pushback damage and is pushed back 6 cells.
mech.wanted.tyranne-la-terrible.echange-.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Do not stay grouped or next to each other.
mech.wanted.tyranne-la-terrible.echange-.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: Pushback damage pushes you back 6 cells along with the characters adjacent to you; "Frappe dévastatrice" gives her +50 pushback damage per character in her radius-3 circle.
mech.wanted.tyranne-la-terrible.echange-.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Avoid being in line at 3 range from her, especially near a wall.
mech.wanted.tyranne-la-terrible.echange-.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: "Hyper Kick" (in line up to 3 range) hits 100 neutral and pushes back 6 cells.

mech.wanted.tyranne-la-terrible.allies-d.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.tyranne-la-terrible.allies-d.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -400 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with her. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.title: Fontaines Laiteuses: stay more than 5 range away
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.summary: No invulnerability. She has no direct-hit spell; each turn she summons a fixed, invulnerable Fontaine Laiteuse that dies after 2 turns, whose checkerboard glyph hits water and removes 100 power. More than 5 range from the fountains, you take neither damage nor penalties.
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.notes.0: A permanent poison hits each character and their allies within radius 2 for earth at the start of their turn.
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.unknownAspects.0: The exact glyph condition (start of your turn and/or the fountain's) is worded ambiguously.
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Before entering: bring characters who hit with Fire or Water.
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: The Vashkiwi has little resistance in Fire (-5%) and Water (5%).
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.sequences.0.steps.2.action: At launch: count the monsters accompanying her.
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Alliés de circonstance": -800 vitality (infinite) per monster present with her.
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Do not stay 2 cells or less from your allies.
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Amis pour la vie": about 100 earth on each character who starts their turn and on their allies within radius 2.
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.sequences.0.steps.4.action: At each new Fontaine Laiteuse: stand more than 5 range from it. Do not try to kill it.
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.sequences.0.steps.4.position: More than 5 range from each fountain
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: Fixed and Invulnerable, it dies on its own after 2 turns; its checkerboard glyph (radius 5) hits 150 water and removes 100 power for 2 turns (stackable).
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Do not remove AP or MP from the monsters.
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: "Sensations Pures": an AP removal gives them 4 AP, an MP removal makes them pull in a size-5 cross.
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.sequences.0.steps.6.action: If she casts "Laitage" on herself: debuff her, then keep hitting her.
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.sequences.0.steps.6.rationale: She gains 1300 shield points and a damage reduction for 2 turns, debuffable.
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.sequences.0.steps.7.action: Go back to step 4 every turn.
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.fontaines.sequences.0.steps.7.rationale: She summons one fountain per turn (never more than two at the same time).

mech.wanted.vashkiwi.conseils.title: Fire/water, no AP/MP removal, debuff her
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.conseils.summary: Little resistance in fire (-5%) and water (5%). Her protected allies gain AP or pull when you try to remove their AP or MP. If she protects herself (shields, 2-turn reduction), debuff her.

mech.wanted.vashkiwi.allies-de-circonsta.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.vashkiwi.allies-de-circonsta.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -800 vitality (infinite) per monster present with her. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.wanted.zatoishwan.distance.title: Attack at range, stay more than 7 range away
mech.wanted.zatoishwan.distance.summary: No invulnerability, but he reduces melee damage by 5 (actual reduction of 42 per hit): favour range. His "Bâton virevoltant" hits very hard when adjacent: stay more than 7 range away (6 MP + melee) at the start of his turn.
mech.wanted.zatoishwan.distance.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.wanted.zatoishwan.distance.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Before entering: favour characters who hit at range.
mech.wanted.zatoishwan.distance.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: "Pandawushu": he reduces melee damage taken by 5 (actual 42 per hit) for the whole fight.
mech.wanted.zatoishwan.distance.sequences.0.steps.2.action: At launch: count the monsters accompanying him.
mech.wanted.zatoishwan.distance.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: "Alliés de circonstance": -1100 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him.
mech.wanted.zatoishwan.distance.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Be more than 7 range from Zatoïshwan at the start of each of his turns.
mech.wanted.zatoishwan.distance.sequences.0.steps.3.position: More than 7 range from the boss
mech.wanted.zatoishwan.distance.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: "Bâton virevoltant" hits 900 air on his 4 adjacent cells and pushes back 4; 7 range = his 6 base MP + melee.
mech.wanted.zatoishwan.distance.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: Melee hits against him are reduced.
mech.wanted.zatoishwan.distance.sequences.0.steps.5.action: From turn 3, account for his boost and his reflection.
mech.wanted.zatoishwan.distance.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: "Colère liquide" (from turn 3, 4-turn cooldown): +200 power, +50 damage, +4 AP for 2 turns, heal of 700 HP and reflection of 40 damage for 3 turns.

mech.wanted.zatoishwan.allies-de-circons.title: "Alliés de circonstance": penalty per accompanying monster
mech.wanted.zatoishwan.allies-de-circons.summary: Common effect of Wanted bosses: -1100 vitality and -50 power (infinite) per monster present with him. Alone in the fight, the boss has no penalty.

mech.cycloide.astuces.title: Cyclaustrophobe and pull: kill it first
mech.cycloide.astuces.summary: Cyclore hits for 600 neutral, removes 4 dodgeable MP and pulls the target 6 cells (up to 7 range, in line). On turn 1 and then every 3 turns, Cyclaustrophobe hits everyone in a size 6 circle: for one turn, each melee hit received sends the target back to its start-of-turn cell and gives it +100 damage for one turn (stacks 3 times).
mech.cycloide.astuces.notes.0: Cyclochette (melee) swaps places with the target and makes it unmovable for 1 turn.
mech.cycloide.astuces.sequences.0.label: How to play it
mech.cycloide.astuces.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Kill it first (except in a team of 6 or more, where the Sinistrofu comes first).
mech.cycloide.astuces.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: MP removal, heavy lock, pull and frequent unmovable state: it is the most annoying monster in the dungeon.
mech.cycloide.astuces.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Stay out of its lines up to 7 range.
mech.cycloide.astuces.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Cyclore pulls 6 cells, so right into melee.
mech.cycloide.astuces.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Under Cyclaustrophobe, hit your biggest damage dealer affected by the spell in melee.
mech.cycloide.astuces.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: They are sent back to their start-of-turn cell but gain +100 damage for one turn per damage line received, stackable: very useful on a Rogue.

mech.granduk.astuces.title: Hiboum: do not hit it at range
mech.granduk.astuces.summary: On the first turn and then every 3 turns, Hiboumerang gives it the Hiboum state (as well as allies in contact with it) for 2 turns: each ranged hit it receives makes it swap places with the attacker and hits entities around your character's arrival cell. Hibougie hits for 30 % of its missing HP.
mech.granduk.astuces.sequences.0.label: How to play it
mech.granduk.astuces.sequences.0.steps.1.action: During Hiboum (2 turns), do not hit it at range.
mech.granduk.astuces.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: It swaps places with you and hits the cells around your arrival point for 100 % of the damage you would have dealt it without resistances.
mech.granduk.astuces.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Only start damaging it if you are sure you can finish it quickly.
mech.granduk.astuces.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Hibougie (3 to 10 range) hits harder the more HP it has lost; erosion reduces this danger.
mech.granduk.astuces.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Avoid giving it free melee zones.
mech.granduk.astuces.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: Hibouffonnerie steals 200 intelligence with each hit and keeps getting stronger.
mech.granduk.astuces.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Tip: deal it a tiny bit of damage so that it stays at range.
mech.granduk.astuces.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: Its ranged spell then deals damage: it hits and runs away instead of coming to hit you in melee.

mech.nocturlabe.astuces.title: Éclaconique: do not hit it in melee
mech.nocturlabe.astuces.summary: From the start of the fight, Tactique du Tic Tac gives it the Éclaconique state: each melee hit it receives is reflected (100 % of the damage received) in a 6-cell area around it, to allies and enemies alike (enemies only take 50 %).
mech.nocturlabe.astuces.notes.0: Tonnerre mécanique (up to 5 range, in line) pulls it 4 cells toward its target and prevents healing for 1 turn.
mech.nocturlabe.astuces.sequences.0.label: How to play it
mech.nocturlabe.astuces.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Hit it at range, never in melee.
mech.nocturlabe.astuces.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: Melee hits are reflected onto everyone around it.
mech.nocturlabe.astuces.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Do not let it reach your characters.
mech.nocturlabe.astuces.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: It has few MP but a lot of lock: once in contact, it quickly becomes a nuisance.
mech.nocturlabe.astuces.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Block it with an entity that has 0 lock (chafer, Pandawa barrel).

mech.sinistrofu.astuces.title: Brouillardent: kill it right after Brumidité
mech.sinistrofu.astuces.summary: Brumidité gives it the Brouillardent state for 1 turn: each time it is hit, it makes all entities within 3 range around it invisible and deals them the damage it received a second time, itself included. Diligence hits for 500 air and steals 4 dodgeable MP, up to 6 range without line of sight.
mech.sinistrofu.astuces.notes.0: In a team of 6 or more, this is the one to kill first (before the Cycloïde).
mech.sinistrofu.astuces.sequences.0.label: How to play it
mech.sinistrofu.astuces.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Kill it as soon as it has cast Brumidité.
mech.sinistrofu.astuces.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: Brouillardent deals your damage to it a second time: it dies very quickly.
mech.sinistrofu.astuces.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Take advantage of the effect to hit the other monsters within 3 range of it.
mech.sinistrofu.astuces.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Damage is doubled on all targets in the area.
mech.sinistrofu.astuces.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Move your allies away from it when you hit it under Brouillardent.
mech.sinistrofu.astuces.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: They also take the repeated damage and become invisible.
mech.sinistrofu.astuces.sequences.0.steps.4.action: If you cannot kill it quickly, bring MP dodge.

mech.strigide.astuces.title: Strident: do not hit it at range
mech.strigide.astuces.summary: Stridicule (turns 1 to 3, then recast on turn 4) gives it +6 range and the Strident state for 2 turns: each time it receives a ranged hit, it removes HP from targets more than 4 range around the target, for 50 % on your allies and 20 % on its allies. Strictus swaps places with the target (up to 8 range with its bonus).
mech.strigide.astuces.sequences.0.label: How to play it
mech.strigide.astuces.sequences.0.steps.1.action: During Strident, do not hit it at range (melee triggers nothing).
mech.strigide.astuces.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: Each ranged hit removes 50 % HP from your distant allies; even if only enemies are hit, some of them hit based on their HP.
mech.strigide.astuces.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: With Stridicule, Strictus swaps places with you up to 8 range (10 on a critical hit).
mech.strigide.astuces.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Be careful in melee: Stricannement hits for 500 water and removes 100 dodge for 1 turn.
mech.strigide.astuces.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: It sometimes avoids taking an area so it can dodge away afterwards.

mech.comte-harebourg.confusions.title: Confusions: your spells are redirected
mech.comte-harebourg.confusions.summary: Throughout the fight, each character receives a confusion at the start of every turn: their spells are redirected by 90° (clockwise), 180° or -90° (counterclockwise). You therefore cannot aim directly at your target. The confusion depends on your vitality percentage at the start of the turn; it is also shown in your effects and in the fight chat.
mech.comte-harebourg.confusions.notes.0: Summons you control (Osamodas, Sadida, Rogue…) have no confusion.
mech.comte-harebourg.confusions.notes.1: Spell redirected to a nonexistent or inaccessible cell (no line of sight): critical failure.
mech.comte-harebourg.confusions.notes.2: For your first Count, kill him last: you will be comfortable with the confusions by the time you need to hit him.
mech.comte-harebourg.confusions.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.comte-harebourg.confusions.sequences.0.steps.1.action: At the start of your turn, read your confusion in your effects or in the fight chat (or from your vitality %: click your life heart to display it).
mech.comte-harebourg.confusions.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: It changes every turn; you only have 30 seconds to play.
mech.comte-harebourg.confusions.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Stand in line or diagonal with the target before casting a spell.
mech.comte-harebourg.confusions.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: This is the simplest and fastest way to know which cell to aim at.
mech.comte-harebourg.confusions.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Aim at the cell that, rotated by your confusion angle, lands on the target (180°: the cell opposite the target).
mech.comte-harebourg.confusions.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: The spell goes in the rotated direction, not where you click.
mech.comte-harebourg.confusions.sequences.0.steps.4.action: If you hit a monster in melee, shift your aim 90° counterclockwise for each damage line already dealt.
mech.comte-harebourg.confusions.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: Each melee damage line changes your confusion by 90° counterclockwise (several times for a multi-line spell). Beyond 10 hits received, the monster no longer changes the confusion.
mech.comte-harebourg.confusions.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Never cast a spell redirected to a nonexistent cell or one without line of sight.
mech.comte-harebourg.confusions.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: It is a critical failure; with your weapon in melee, you skip your turn.

mech.comte-harebourg.sorts.title: Mi-temps glyph and the Count's spells
mech.comte-harebourg.sorts.summary: At the start of each of his turns, the Count places a size 3 cross-shaped glyph around himself, center included (Mi-temps): an ally who starts their turn inside it is killed; the glyph lasts 1 turn. Contretemps hits for 700 earth plus a water line (7 % of the target's missing HP), up to 14 range in line without line of sight; when the Count is vulnerable, it also sends the target back to its start-of-turn cell.
mech.comte-harebourg.sorts.notes.0: Since 3.5, the center cell of the Mi-temps glyph is also glyphed: carrying the Count with a Pandawa no longer works.
mech.comte-harebourg.sorts.notes.1: Jaquemart is only cast while the Count is invulnerable; Multicomte only on the turn after his invulnerability is removed.
mech.comte-harebourg.sorts.sequences.0.label: How to play against his spells
mech.comte-harebourg.sorts.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Never end your turn within 3 cells of the Count in a cross around him (or on his cell).
mech.comte-harebourg.sorts.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: He places his Mi-temps glyph at the start of his turn: an ally who starts their turn inside it dies.
mech.comte-harebourg.sorts.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Stay out of his lines as much as possible.
mech.comte-harebourg.sorts.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: He only has 5 MP and mostly hits in line (Contretemps up to 14 range, Jaquemart at 4 range).
mech.comte-harebourg.sorts.sequences.0.steps.3.action: While he is invulnerable, watch out for Jaquemart: 700 water that steals HP and -3 dodgeable AP, up to 4 range without line of sight.
mech.comte-harebourg.sorts.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: This spell is no longer used once he loses his invulnerability.
mech.comte-harebourg.sorts.sequences.0.steps.4.action: On the turn after removing his invulnerability, anticipate Multicomte and Contretemps.
mech.comte-harebourg.sorts.sequences.0.steps.4.rationale: Multicomte hits for 500 fire in a ring of radius 3 to 5 and creates illusions; Contretemps sends the target back to its start-of-turn cell, possibly into his glyph.
mech.comte-harebourg.sorts.sequences.0.steps.5.action: To push him away or steer him, give him a summon to hit at 5 range.
mech.comte-harebourg.sorts.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: If it is the only thing in his line of sight, he uses all his MP to kill it; the next turn, another summon 5 range further leads him elsewhere.

mech.comte-harebourg.strategie.title: Dungeon fight plan
mech.comte-harebourg.strategie.summary: The real difficulty of the dungeon is juggling the confusions. Kill the most annoying monsters first (the Cycloïde, or the Sinistrofu in a team of 6 or more) and, for a first attempt, keep the Count for last: you will be comfortable with the confusions when it is time to remove his invulnerability (even turn).
mech.comte-harebourg.strategie.notes.0: You only have 30 seconds per turn: practice the confusions rather than trying to work out a pattern during the fight.
mech.comte-harebourg.strategie.sequences.0.label: Steps to follow
mech.comte-harebourg.strategie.sequences.0.steps.1.action: Before entering: for a first Count, a Pandawa, Masqueraider, Iop and Eniripsa team is recommended.
mech.comte-harebourg.strategie.sequences.0.steps.1.rationale: Pandawa for positioning, shields and heals to leave room for mistakes, Iop to kill the monsters quickly.
mech.comte-harebourg.strategie.sequences.0.steps.2.action: Read the tips for the dungeon's monsters (Cycloïde, Granduk, Nocturlabe, Sinistrofu, Strigide).
mech.comte-harebourg.strategie.sequences.0.steps.2.rationale: Several of them punish melee or ranged hits.
mech.comte-harebourg.strategie.sequences.0.steps.3.action: Kill the Cycloïde first (the Sinistrofu first if you are 6 or more).
mech.comte-harebourg.strategie.sequences.0.steps.3.rationale: They are the most annoying: MP removal, lock, pull. The order of the others matters little; the Granduk reaches melee faster than the Nocturlabe.
mech.comte-harebourg.strategie.sequences.0.steps.4.action: Cast your spells in line or diagonal with the target, reading your confusion at the start of each turn.
mech.comte-harebourg.strategie.sequences.0.steps.5.action: Keep the Count for last and keep him at a distance in the meantime.
mech.comte-harebourg.strategie.sequences.0.steps.5.rationale: He only has 5 MP; a summon placed at 5 range draws him wherever you want.
mech.comte-harebourg.strategie.sequences.0.steps.6.action: When he is alone, remove his invulnerability on an even turn and hit him hard with the ally who swapped places with him (+100 damage).
